1inch Aqua.revenue: The 1inch DAO's encoded share of each fill's swap fee: 1/4 of the LP fee on low-fee tiers (below ~0.1225%) and 1/6 on higher tiers, transferred to the purpose-deployed per-chain DAO fee exchanger at fill time. Positions created before the DAO fee launch (2026-07-19; enabled 2026-07-21 on BNB Chain and Robinhood Chain) carry no DAO fee and contribute only to SupplySideRevenue. Cross-checked against measured ERC20 inflows to the fee exchangers.
1inch Aqua.fees: Total Aqua swap fees paid by takers: each fill's taker-paid amount (Pushed event on the AquaRouter registry, fee-inclusive; strategy-registration pushes excluded) multiplied by the position's fee rate decoded from its on-chain strategy bytecode (SwapVM flat-fee instruction, 1e9 units = 100%). When a maker's own strategies trade against each other within one transaction, the LP fee is paid back to the same wallet and only counts on the maker's net change; the DAO share is always counted. Fills of positions on the legacy developer-release registry (pre-2026-07-19, a handful of test positions on an earlier instruction set) are excluded.

40 Acres.revenue: Amount of fees that go to 40acres treasury.
40 Acres.fees: Includes 0.8% fee charged to open a line of credit, 5% of voting rewards that are directed to the protocol treasury and 1% fee on rewards and 20 % of voting rewards that are directed to lenders

7.exchange.revenue: All integrator fees charged by 7.exchange are retained by 7.exchange, so revenue equals fees.
7.exchange.fees: Integrator fees charged by 7.exchange on finalized swaps (the integrator_fee item). Excludes gas, relayer, and other third-party costs.

9Summits.fees: Total yields from deposited assets in all curated vaults.

9mm V3.revenue: Share of the swap fee the pool keeps for the protocol, set from its fee tier: 33% on the 0.01% tier, 34% on 0.05%, 32% on 0.25% and 1%.
9mm V3.fees: Traders pay each pool's configured fee tier on every swap.

AGNT.revenue: Fees kept by AGNT: the 32% platform share of launchpad pool fees (WETH released by the Doppler initializers on Base + Robinhood, to 0x5bF5805e…C5f0) plus 100% of the 0.40% swap fee (WETH + USDC paid by Relay on Base to the app-fee recipient wallets — 0x585b6854…0598 pre-repoint and 0x5bF5805e…C5f0 post-repoint) plus AGNT's ~2/7 (28.57%) protocol cut of PonsV2 launch fees on Robinhood (the `toAgnt` leg of each AgntFeeWedge Split; the remaining 5/7 is forwarded to each token's own engine) plus 100% of AGNTS NFT mint proceeds on Robinhood (a first-party collection, so there is no creator split) plus 100% of AGNTS activation ETH fees and swap fees, and the full $AGNTS activation cost (the treasury share plus the burned share).
AGNT.fees: Total fees paid by users on AGNT: (1) the 1.095% Doppler V4 terminal pool fee on tokens launched via the launchpad on Base + Robinhood Chain, derived from the observed on-chain platform fee share (WETH on Base; WETH plus RWA numeraires — tokenized stocks like AAPL that a Robinhood launch pairs against, e.g. $BEER — on Robinhood, priced by DefiLlama; the unpriced launched-token leg is excluded, a conservative lower bound); plus (2) the 0.40% platform fee on in-app swaps (Base), measured as WETH + USDC paid by Relay to AGNT's app-fee recipient wallet; plus (3) fees from PonsV2 launches on Robinhood Chain, read from each token's AgntFeeWedge Split events (native-ETH leg = total user-paid fee); plus (4) native-ETH paid by buyers to mint AGNT's own AGNTS PFP collection on Robinhood Chain; plus (5) AGNTS activation fees on Robinhood Chain (ETH fee + $AGNTS cost, from the Activated event); plus (6) AGNTS NFT swap fees on Robinhood Chain (random packs and exact picks; the fee is read from the swap engine at each swap's block).

ALPHA Launchpad.revenue: The 1% protocol fee taken on every trade.
ALPHA Launchpad.fees: Trading fees paid by traders on bonding curves and on graduated pools: a 1% protocol fee plus a creator fee of 0, 0.25 or 0.5%. On Solana, graduated pool fees are the ALPHA share of the Meteora DAMM v2 pool fee, counted when claimed, and the fee on a creator's first buy inside the launch transaction is not counted because no event reports it.

ARMSys.revenue: The hook's treasury share of swap fees (HookFeeCollected events), excluding the protocol's own keeper flow.
ARMSys.fees: Swap fees paid by traders in ARMSys dynamic-fee pools (LP fee from PoolManager Swap events + the hook's treasury share from HookFeeCollected). Swaps made by the protocol's own keeper are excluded.

AUTOfinance.revenue: Performance fees charged on positive performance and management fees if any
AUTOfinance.fees: Includes Yields on all the vaults, performance fees and management fees

Aave Labs.revenue: All swap fees are collected as revenue.
Aave Labs.fees: All swap fees from Aave frontend using CowSwap integration.

Aave V3.revenue: Amount of fees go to Aave treasury.
Aave V3.fees: Include borrow interest, flashloan fee, liquidation fee, penalty paid by borrowers, swap fees from the Aave frontend (Paraswap, then CoW Swap), and Chainlink SVR (MEV recapture from Ethereum liquidations).

Aave V4.revenue: Protocol share of borrow interest plus protocol share of liquidation bonuses.
Aave V4.fees: Borrow interest paid by borrowers plus protocol share of liquidation bonuses.

Accountable.revenue: The Accountable protocol's share of the performance and management fees.
Accountable.fees: Value earned by Accountable vaults over the day, read on chain: for credit vaults the interest accrued by borrowers, for NAV, looping and fixed-term vaults the increase in share price plus the fee shares minted out of it, and for collateral fixed-term vaults the one-off management fee charged at loan acceptance, spread evenly over the loan term.

Across.fees: Total fees paid by users for bridge txs.

Adexto.revenue: The protocol leg of every swap, paid to the ADEXTO protocol treasury: 0.10% of the trade on factory 0.11.0, 0.12.0 and 1.0.0 markets, where it is a factory constant. Factory 0.10.0 markets have no protocol leg.
Adexto.fees: All swap fees paid by traders on ADEXTO bonding curves, read from each Swap event: the creator, curve reserve, buyback and protocol legs. Rates are set per market at launch and never change; the launch presets are 1.00% on factory 1.0.0 and 0.12.0 markets and 0.40% on factory 0.11.0 markets.

Aera V3.revenue: Revenue represents Aera's share of vault performance.
Aera V3.fees: Fees reflect the daily gains or losses generated by vault assets.

Aero Basic.revenue: Swap fees earned by AERO-earning liquidity and bribes, all distributed to sAERO holders.
Aero Basic.fees: Swap fees paid by traders, plus bribes paid to the protocol to attract AERO Rewards to pools.

Aero Slipstream.revenue: Swap fees earned by AERO-earning liquidity, the protocol share of fee-earning liquidity fees and bribes, all distributed to sAERO holders.
Aero Slipstream.fees: Swap fees paid by traders, plus bribes paid to the protocol to attract AERO Rewards to pools.

Aerodrome Slipstream.revenue: Swap fees earned by liquidity staked in gauges plus the cut taken from unstaked liquidity, and bribes, paid to veAERO voters, plus those staked-liquidity fees locked in the gauges since their last fee distribution on 2026-10-15.
Aerodrome Slipstream.fees: Swap fees paid by traders, plus bribes deposited for veAERO voters until voting ended with the Aero upgrade on 2026-10-22.

Aerodrome V1.revenue: Swap fees earned by liquidity staked in gauges and bribes, paid to veAERO voters, plus the staked-liquidity fees locked in the gauges since their last fee distribution on 2026-10-15.
Aerodrome V1.fees: Swap fees paid by traders, plus bribes deposited for veAERO voters until voting ended with the Aero upgrade on 2026-10-22.

Ajna V2.revenue: ~10-15% of borrower interest accumulated in pool reserves, held by the protocol pending reserve auctions
Ajna V2.fees: Total interest paid by borrowers: ~85-90% to lenders and ~10-15% to protocol reserves

Alchemix V3.revenue: MYT performance fees and realized Alchemist/Transmuter protocol fees collected by the Alchemix protocol.
Alchemix V3.fees: Gross yield generated by all Alchemix V3 ERC-4626 (MYT) vaults, measured from each vault's share-price (convertToAssets) growth over the measurement period and grossed up by the on-chain performanceFee(), plus realized Alchemist/Transmuter protocol fees transferred to the fee receiver.

AlfaClub V1.revenue: Platform slices of key-trade fees plus flat dispatch fees paid to the protocol treasury.
AlfaClub V1.fees: All user-paid slices on key trades and fund dispatch: platform + creator + trading-fund + $3 dispatch. Exclusive of bonding-curve price. Performance / bridge fees on FriendStake clones are not counted in v1 (beacon clones; 0 recent distributions).

Alkimiya.revenue: All fill fees accrue as protocol revenue.
Alkimiya.fees: Fill fees charged by the SilicaPools contract when users fill orders for hashpower derivatives.

Allbridge Core.fees: Bridge fees (a share of the transferred stablecoin) plus relayer fees (paid in native gas or deducted from the stablecoin) paid by users on the source chain of every Allbridge Core transfer.

AlloX.revenue: Swap fees: 0.25% of every swap output collected + user payments to the AlloX message-purchase
AlloX.fees: Swap fees: 0.25% of every swap output collected + Chat-message fees: user payments to the AlloX message-purchase

Alphix.revenue: Share of 30% yields from deployed lending strategies to Alphix.
Alphix.fees: Total swap fees from Uniswap pools + yields from deployed lending strategies.

Amped Finance.revenue: 30% of the fees goes to AMPED stakers.
Amped Finance.fees: Fees collected from trading, liquidation, and margin activities.

Anthias Labs.fees: Total yields from deposited assets in all curated vaults.

Aori.fees: Fees is calculated as the difference between the input and output amounts.

Ape.Store.revenue: Total fees paid by users for creating and trading tokens.
Ape.Store.fees: Total fees paid by users for creating and trading tokens.

Apex DeFi.revenue: Protocol fees from DEX trades (0.1% per trade) and Burst trades (0.75% per trade plus launch fees)
Apex DeFi.fees: DEX swap fees (0.3% per trade) and Burst bonding curve fees (1% per trade plus launch fees)

Apostro.fees: Total yields from deposited assets in all curated vaults.

Arcadia V2.revenue: Treasury share of borrow interest and liquidations, plus full origination fees and performance fees (a percentage of earned yield) from automated and manual front-end actions.
Arcadia V2.fees: Total fees paid, including borrow interest, origination fees, liquidation penalties, plus performance fees (a percentage of earned yield) charged on automated actions and manual front-end actions.

Architect.fees: Total yields from deposited assets in all curated vaults.

Arkada.revenue: 100% of pyramid claim fees and verification fees are retained by Arkada.
Arkada.fees: All fees paid by users for Arkada pyramid claims and paid verifications.

Arrakis Modular.revenue: Manager fee taken by Arrakis out of the trading fees earned by vault positions.
Arrakis Modular.fees: Gross trading fees earned by Arrakis Modular vault positions, recovered from the manager fee actually taken out of each position and the manager fee share that was in force for that vault at the moment the fee was taken. Vaults on the Uniswap V3 module, which pays the manager without emitting an event, are not included.

AssetClaw.revenue: The AssetClaw fee on RWA Native route transfers, all kept by the AssetClaw treasury.
AssetClaw.fees: RWA Native route only: the AssetClaw fee paid to the treasury, 1% of the amount, 0.5% for Genesis 625 NFT holders. Privacy and Standard route fees are not counted.

Auki.revenue: All the Auki tokens spent on credits are burnt
Auki.fees: Auki tokens spent to buy credits to use across the network.

Autopilot.revenue: 5% of the rewards going to treasury
Autopilot.fees: Aerodrome weekly rewards received by veAero staked in the pool

Avalon Finance.revenue: Percentage of interest going to treasury

Avantgarde.fees: Total yields from deposited assets in all curated vaults.

Ave.ai.revenue: All fees are collected by the protocol.
Ave.ai.fees: Fees collected on each swap (0.5% for chain wallets, 0.8% for bot wallets).

Axelar.fees: Total gas fees paid by users (excluding gas refunds)

Axiom.revenue: Revenue is fees retained by Axiom after deducting referral and cashback payouts.
Axiom.fees: Every trading fee Axiom users pay, measured as the SOL that lands in Axiom's fee wallets on swaps routed through Axiom, plus the referral payouts users later claim from referral vaults (funded inside the swap). Cashback is paid from the fee wallets, so it is already included. On its EVM chains it is the native token the trade contracts pay into Axiom's fee distributors.

Azuro.revenue: Total pools profits (equals total bets amount minus total won bets amount)
Azuro.fees: Total pools profits (equals total bets amount minus total won bets amount)

B.Protocol Curator.fees: Total yields from deposited assets in all curated vaults.

BCraft.fees: Tokens trading and launching fees paid by users.

BIM Yield.revenue: 9% of each harvest is charged as a performance fee for staking, 0.25% for every swap and 0.125% for every bridge.
BIM Yield.fees: 9% of each harvest is charged as a performance fee for staking, 0.25% for every swap and 0.125% for every bridge.

BMX Classic Perps.revenue: Revenue is 40% of all collected fees, distributed to BMX/wBLT LP stakers and BMX stakers. Note: actual fee splits vary by product (Classic: 20%, Freestyle/Carousel: 60%, Deli Swap: 3%)
BMX Classic Perps.fees: Fees from open/close position (0.1%), liquidations, swap (0.2% to 0.8%), mint and burn (based on tokens balance in the pool) and borrow fee ((assets borrowed)/(total assets in pool)*0.01%)

BabyDoge Bridge.revenue: Protocol fees retained by BabyDoge Bridge from bridging operations
BabyDoge Bridge.fees: Fees paid by users for bridging assets cross-chain via BabyDoge Bridge

BackedFi.revenue: All fees are revenue for the protocol
BackedFi.fees: Up to 0.50% of your investment's value is charged when entering and exiting the investment (0 fees as of now)

Balancer V2.revenue: Balancer V2 protocol collects 50% swap fees as revenue.
Balancer V2.fees: All trading fees collected (includes swap and yield fee)

Balancer V3.revenue: Revenue earned by the protocol and holders, which is 25% ( 50 % before 2026-04-23 ) of the trade fees and 10% of the yield capture.
Balancer V3.fees: Fees earned from all the trades and yields.

Banana Gun.revenue: Fees collected by Banana Bot protocol.
Banana Gun.fees: All trading fees paid by users for using Banana Bot.

Bankr.revenue: Bankr's fees from token launches and integrations, read on-chain per chain since 2026-07-03. Before that, the dashboard's combined figure is reported on Base, plus Bankr's share of Clanker v3 and v3.1 LP fees read on-chain, which the dashboard leaves out.
Bankr.fees: Creator fees plus Bankr's own fees from token launches and integrations. Bankr's fees are the tokens its fee contracts pay to Bankr's three fee addresses on each chain, plus, on Base, Bankr's share of LP fees on Clanker v3 and v3.1 tokens paid through 0xSplits splits, priced with DefiLlama prices; fees paid in tokens launched on Bankr's Doppler launchpad (addresses ending in ba3) are left out. Creator fees come from Bankr's dashboard, per chain.

Barker.revenue: All x402 call fees paid by AI agents are kept by the protocol.
Barker.fees: x402 pay-per-call fees paid by AI agents for Barker's MCP stablecoin-yield tools ($0.001–$0.05 per call), settled onchain in stablecoins to the protocol payment wallet.

Base App.revenue: Fees collected by Coinbase paid by users for trading, swapping, bridging in Coinbase Wallet, in tokens and in the native coin, and referral fees from coins created in the Base App. Excludes what the fee wallet receives in its own swaps. On OP Mainnet, token fees are counted only before 2026-10-07.
Base App.fees: All fees paid by users for trading, swapping, bridging in Coinbase Wallet, in tokens and in the native coin, and referral fees from coins created in the Base App. Excludes what the fee wallet receives in its own swaps. On OP Mainnet, token fees are counted only before 2026-10-07.

Base Dollar.revenue: Share of borrow interest to protocol if any
Base Dollar.fees: Total interest, redemption fees paid by borrowers and liquidation profit

BasePaint.fees: Fees paid by users for using BasePaint services.

BaseStonk.revenue: The platform's cut of the tax plus what reaches BSTONK holders: half the tax capped at 1% of the trade to the treasury, any part of the creator's cut the payee list left unplaced and the hook swept to the treasury, and the share of the creator's cut paid to BSTONK's dividend distributor, to the BSTONK basket vault, or burnt as BSTONK.
BaseStonk.fees: The tax BaseStonk's Uniswap v4 hook takes on every swap in a launched token's pool, from the hook's FeeTaken event. Each launch sets its own buy and sell rate. A buy pays the tax in the launch token and a sell in the pair; token-denominated amounts are converted into the pair at the pool price the same transaction's Swap reports.

BaseSwap V2.revenue: 32% of swap fees (0.08% of volume) go to the BaseSwap protocol.
BaseSwap V2.fees: Traders pay a 0.25% fee on every swap in BaseSwap V2 pairs.

BaseX.revenue: Share of swap fees kept by the protocol, read per pool from slot0.feeProtocol (25% on pools where it is enabled, 0% otherwise).
BaseX.fees: Swap fees paid by traders at each pool's fee tier.

Basecamp.fees: Tokens trading and launching fees paid by users.

Based Aggregator.revenue: All app fees accrue to the Based protocol; there is no supply-side or holder share.
Based Aggregator.fees: 1% (100 bps) app fee charged on swaps routed through Relay, collected in USDC. Reported per origin chain of the swap.

Basenames.revenue: 100% of registration and renewal payments are retained by the protocol. Collected ETH is swept in full to a single payment receiver, with no referrer or supply-side split.
Basenames.fees: Total ETH paid by users to register or renew Basenames, taken from the `price` field of ETHPaymentProcessed events (post-discount cost, excluding overpayment refunds).

BeFi Perps.revenue: builder code revenue from Symmio Perps Trades.
BeFi Perps.fees: builder code fees from Symmio Perps Trades.

Bedrock uniBTC.revenue: all uniBTC redemption fees are retained by Bedrock.
Bedrock uniBTC.fees: uniBTC redemption fees paid by users when delayed redemption requests are created.

Beefy.revenue: All fees except for 0.5% to strategist and variable harvest() call fee are revenue
Beefy.fees: 9.5% of each harvest is charged as a performance fee

Beezie.revenue: Beezie keeps 100% of all fees - no share goes to sellers, creators, or LPs.
Beezie.fees: 6% on every BidRouter swap-back and marketplace sale, plus (until 2026-07-23) 5% of each claw pull taken by V1/V2 machines at play time. ClawMachineV3 no longer takes a pull-time cut: the full play price goes to the claw finance wallet and Beezie's take is realized as the 6% fee when cards are swapped back through the BidRouter - the same model as Solana, where the claw take is the 6% swap fee alone and the marketplace's 6% is paid out by the Metaplex Core royalties plugin. Trade volume itself is not counted - only Beezie's cut.

BetSwirl.revenue: Dividends, Treasury and Team fee allocations.
BetSwirl.fees: All fees (called «house edge» from 2.4% to 4% of the payout) comes from the player's bet. The fee has several allocations: Bank, Partner, Affiliate, Dividends, Treasury, and Team. The house edge on PvP games is from 3.5% to 7% allocated to Dividends, Host, Affiliate, Treasury and Team.

Binance Alpha.revenue: All fees are collected by Binance.
Binance Alpha.fees: Fees paid by users while trading via Binance Alpha app.

BitFi BTC.revenue: Withdrawal fees collected by the BitFi protocol fee receiver.
BitFi BTC.fees: Withdrawal fees from bfBTC paid by users, plus bfBTC strategy yield accrued through bfBTC/BTC exchange-rate appreciation.

Bitwise.fees: Total yields from deposited assets in all curated vaults.

BlazingApp.revenue: All trading revenue goes to the protocol.
BlazingApp.fees: All trading fees paid by users.

Block Analitica.fees: Total yields from deposited assets in all curated vaults.

Bloom Trading Bot.revenue: Trading fees kept by Bloom protocol after referral and cashback rewards.
Bloom Trading Bot.fees: All trading fees paid by users while using Bloom Trading bot.

Boardwalk.revenue: Boardwalk's share of the transfer tax (default 35bps of the 95bps tax, 30bps when a referrer is set), split 10% treasury / 90% governance. Revenue from non-Ethereum chains is bridged weekly to Ethereum, where the split applies (net of bridge fees).
Boardwalk.fees: Transfer tax (0.95% default, higher during the anti-whale decay window after launch) charged on every non-exempt transfer of Boardwalk-launched tokens, valued in WETH at the launch pair spot rate. The Uniswap v2 pair fee is not counted.

Bonker.revenue: Bonker's protocol fee, equal to 20% of the imposed LP fee and paid to the Bonker factory.
Bonker.fees: Total swap fees paid by traders in Bonker-launched Uniswap v4 pools: protocol fees realized by the Bonker hooks plus LP fees credited by the Bonker LP locker.

Boson Protocol.fees: A fee is charged on every successful trade executed on the Boson Protocol.

Bungee Bridge Aggregator.revenue: Total fees paid are distributed to Bungee integrations.
Bungee Bridge Aggregator.fees: Total fees paid by users from swap and bridge transactions.

CURB.revenue: The platform's share of the tax (0.50% of the trade at deployment, frozen into each launch), plus the creator share of launches whose creator wallet is the treasury ($CURB).
CURB.fees: The trading tax (1%-5%, set per launch) paid on every curve and graduated-pool trade, in the quote asset. The pools' 0.05% Uniswap v4 LP fee is not included: it is earned by the pool's liquidity and already counted by the Uniswap v4 adapter.

CallPut.revenue: The share of fees allocated to the CallPut treasury and governance addresses, based on the FeeDistributor's onchain OLP reward rate, minus referral and copy-trading rebates.
CallPut.fees: Options trading fees and liquidity and swap fees paid by CallPut users.

Carbon.inc.revenue: All the trading fees are revenue
Carbon.inc.fees: Perp trading fees paid by users

Central City.revenue: The full 10% protocol fee on qualifying Feed service payments, which AI agents make in USDC on Base and Arc for services on Central City's Feed, kept by Central City: the immutable fee routers send it straight to the Central City treasury. Includes payments made by all agents created on Central City, counted under the same rules.
Central City.fees: The 10% protocol fee on qualifying Feed service payments, which AI agents make in USDC on Base and Arc for services on Central City's Feed (other payments carry no fee), charged by Central City's immutable fee routers and sent straight to the Central City treasury. Includes payments made by all agents created on Central City, counted under the same rules.

Centrifuge Protocol.revenue: Management fees from all the vaults
Centrifuge Protocol.fees: Includes management fees and yields from all the vaults

Chain Daddy.revenue: Chain Daddy's share of the trading fees in its launchpad pools, fixed in each pool when it launches: 20% of the LP fee for EVM pools launched since 2026-10-10 (earlier pools carry 5%, 15% or 20%), and 20% of the Solana bonding curve trading fee for pools launched since 2026-10-10 (earlier configs 5% or 15%).
Chain Daddy.fees: Trading fees paid by traders in pools created by Chain Daddy's launchpad: the LP fee of the Uniswap pools it creates through Doppler on EVM chains (a locked Uniswap v3 pool for a default launch, a Uniswap v4 pool for its other launch modes), and the trading fee of its Meteora Dynamic Bonding Curve pools on Solana after Meteora's protocol and referral fees. Excludes the separate hook fee of Doppler Rehype pools, which goes wholly to each coin's own fee address, a burn or its holders, Uniswap's protocol fee where it is switched on, and Chain Daddy's token page and token creation fees, which are paid by card or as plain transfers.

Chainchat.revenue: Fees paid by users while trading on social network.
Chainchat.fees: Fees paid by users while trading on social network.

Chamber Vaults.revenue: All revenue collected by the dHEDGE protocol from fees generated: the DAO fee (daoFee) collected from all vaults.
Chamber Vaults.fees: All fees generated from dHEDGE vaults: manager fees (performance and management) and deposit/withdraw fees from dHEDGE vaults, excluding Toros and mStable vaults which are tracked in their own adapters, plus the dHEDGE DAO fee collected from all vaults on the platform.

Charm Finance V2.revenue: 2-5% swap fees taken as performance fees
Charm Finance V2.fees: Swap fees generated by providing liquidity to pools of various protocols

CheapGM.revenue: fees accrue to protocol treasury. If no GMCounter address provided for a chain, fallback is treasury net inflow for that chain/day.
CheapGM.fees: fees from GMCounter logs: if referral is set, fee x (1 - referralFees/BPS), otherwise full fee.

Chedda Finance.revenue: Portion of interest from lending pools, based on reserve factor.
Chedda Finance.fees: Interest accrued from lending pools, collected as fees.

Circle CCTP.fees: Fast transfer fees(0-14 BPs) and forward fees charged by CCTP

ClaimRush.revenue: ETH paid as royalties on every Mine takeover.
ClaimRush.fees: ETH paid as royalties on every Mine takeover. Gross protocol revenue is the sum of every `ShareholderTakeoverAllocation.amountEth` emitted by the ShareholderRoyalties contract.

ClawdStrategy.revenue: Same as Fees. ClawdStrategy does not charge a supply-side fee — 100% of agent-generated income is paid out from the Treasury, so dailyRevenue equals dailyFees.
ClawdStrategy.fees: Total cbBTC distributed by the ClawdStrategy Treasury to STRI holders. Represents the gross income generated by the AI compute agents that is paid out to the protocol's tokenholders.

Clearpool Lending.revenue: Protocol share of Dynamic pool borrower interest, plus Prime pool spreadFee and originationFee repayment fees.
Clearpool Lending.fees: Interest and protocol fees generated by Clearpool lending products: Dynamic pools, Prime pool repayment fees, and Port vault NAV yield.

Clearstar.fees: Total yields from deposited assets in all curated vaults.

Clipper.revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders

Clober V2.fees: fees include the portion captured by the meta aggregator from the spread between the best quote and the second best quote

Clutch Anvil AMM.revenue: Robinhood Chain only: 50% of the flat ETH swap fee to the protocol treasury, plus 100% of loan-creation and soft-staking activation ETH fees to the treasury.
Clutch Anvil AMM.fees: Sum of protocolFee + stakerFee fields from NFTBought + NFTSold events. Protocol fee is burned; staker fee streams to the NFT staking vault as rewards. On Robinhood Chain every swap additionally pays a flat oracle-priced ~$2 ETH fee (RobinhoodSwapFeePaid), every loan create pays ~$2 ETH (LoanEthFeePaid), and every soft-staking activate/upgrade pays ~$1 ETH (ActivationEthFeePaid).

CoWSwap.revenue: CoW DAO share: protocol fees, ~25% partner service fee, and 50% of MEV Blocker fees/sale proceeds
CoWSwap.fees: Swap fees from the sell token: protocol fees (50% surplus + 2bps volume), partner fees, and MEV Blocker fees

CoinLotto.revenue: Protocol fees on ticket purchases kept by CoinLotto after the referrer share, including the Super Lottery fee taken on feeder allocations, excluding CLT-denominated fees.
CoinLotto.fees: Protocol fees and lottery creator fees charged on ticket purchases, including the protocol fee share passed to referrers. Prize pools, Super Lottery allocations, prize pool top-ups, prize payouts and CLT-denominated fees are excluded; CLT-denominated fees are temporarily out of scope of this integration.

Coinbase Bridge.fees: No fees are charged when minting and redeeming cbBTC.

Coinbase Commerce.revenue: All fees paid by merchants using Coinbase Commerce, and from 2026-04-02 its replacement Coinbase Business on Base.
Coinbase Commerce.fees: All fees paid by merchants using Coinbase Commerce, and from 2026-04-02 its replacement Coinbase Business on Base.

Collector Crypt.revenue: Gacha card pack sales and marketplace royalties net of gacha pack buybacks, plus the LP fees the treasury claims from the CARDS/USDC pool, all kept by the protocol.
Collector Crypt.fees: Gacha card pack sales (on-chain on Solana, Base and Robinhood Chain, and fiat/credit-card) and marketplace royalties, net of gacha pack buybacks, plus the LP fees the treasury claims from the CARDS/USDC pool.

Compound V3.revenue: Spread between borrow interest paid by borrowers and supply interest distributed to lenders. Accumulates as protocol reserves on each Comet contract, withdrawable to the Compound DAO Treasury via Governance.
Compound V3.fees: Total borrow interest paid by borrowers across Compound V3 markets.

Contango V2.revenue: Revenue consists of the service fees collected from trades on both correlated and non-correlated pairs.
Contango V2.fees: Trading fees include 0.05% for correlated pairs and 0.25% for non-correlated pairs, plus automation fees for TP/SL orders and flash loan fees.

Creator Bid.revenue: Fees paid by users when creating and trading AI agents.
Creator Bid.fees: Fees paid by users when creating and trading AI agents.

Curve DEX.revenue: The share of pool fees kept by the protocol rather than paid to liquidity providers - usually half of the fee - plus bribes.
Curve DEX.fees: Swap and liquidity fees charged by Curve pools, plus bribes paid to veCRV voters. Fee rates are set per pool - around 0.01%-0.04% on stable pools and up to a few percent on volatile pools.

Cybro.revenue: ProtocolFeeCollector keeps the whole cut. Pool fees that stay with the user are not included.
Cybro.fees: Cybro LP and auto managers charge 10 bps when a position is opened, increased, withdrawn or moved, and 10 bps of pool fees that are claimed or compounded. The cut is an ERC-20 transfer into ProtocolFeeCollector.

D2 Finance.revenue: 20% performance fee, 0% management fee on the flagship strategy, and 2% management fee on other strategies.
D2 Finance.fees: All yields are generated from all staking assets across all trading strategies.

D8X.fees: Trading and liquidation fees paid by traders.

DEX Screener.fees: All fees paid by users for token profile listing.

DEXR.revenue: 100% of the 0.3% protocol fee flows to a Gnosis Safe multisig (no token holders, no buyback). The same Safe address (0xD55cE54Ce3e0985867CD57f4266c27a5b060D665) is replicated across all chains. Revenue equals fees.
DEXR.fees: DEXR charges a flat 0.3% protocol fee on the input token (tokenIn) of every swap. The feeAmount field of the SwapExecuted event captures this exactly. The same 0.3% rate applies to LI.FI-routed flows but those fees are collected via the LI.FI integrator portal, not on-chain — and are not counted here.

DEXTools.fees: All fees paid by users for token profile listing.

DIEM Relay.revenue: All the compute revenue (Venice AI inference sold via cheaptokens.ai) either retained by the protocol (currently 10%, historically 20%) or streamed to sDIEM stakers.
DIEM Relay.fees: USDC compute revenue (Venice AI inference sold via cheaptokens.ai) distributed by the DIEM Relay RevenueSplitter contracts.

DLMM KING Pools.revenue: Protocol operations share of swap fees.
DLMM KING Pools.fees: Swap fees paid by users in SectorOne Uniswap v2 and Liquidity Book pools.

DODO AMM.revenue: 20% of swap fees retained by the protocol treasury
DODO AMM.fees: All swap fees collected from DODO trading pairs across all pools

DYLI.revenue: Onchain USDC fees and payment flows retained by DYLI.
DYLI.fees: USDC service payments and Gacha sales, including verified Stripe-funded Base purchases, after subtracting vending-machine buybacks and refunds, plus 5% marketplace fees. Base crypto sales use Bought.onchainCost; Stripe sales are matched to onchain Bought events using public payment evidence. P2P fees are 2.5% of volume on Abstract and actual platform-wallet commissions on Base. Contracts switch from Abstract to Base on October 13, 2026 at 16:00 UTC; Abstract vault-payment receipts remain tracked afterward. Other offchain sales are excluded.

DackieSwap V2.fees: All fees comes from the user.

DackieSwap V3.revenue: Protocol fees collected by DackieSwap - 0.05% of each trade for most pools
DackieSwap V3.fees: Total trading fees - sum of LP fees and protocol fees. LP fees vary by pool type (0.25% for most pools, with some special pools having different rates). Protocol fees are 0.05% for most pools.

DashsWallet.revenue: Portion of surplus retained by the DashsWallet treasury after deducting cashback.
DashsWallet.fees: Total surplus captured on DashsWallet swaps — difference between actual swap output and the user's minimum accepted amount.

DeBank Cloud.revenue: All on-chain deposits and swap fees collected by DeBank. Card/fiat payments are not included as they are settled off-chain.
DeBank Cloud.fees: USDC/USDT deposits paid by users to top up DeBank Cloud / DeBank credit, plus swap fees collected by DeBank. Note: this does not include payments made by card/fiat, which DeBank also supports but are settled off-chain.

DeepCore.revenue: The protocol fee slice each Swap event carried, plus the router fee on routed fills. Both are paid to the protocol.
DeepCore.fees: Swap fees charged by DeepCore pools, read from each Swap event (protocol fee included), plus the fee DeepCore's router charges on fills it routes to other venues, read from its Filled events. Launch-pool creator taxes and launch-guard trade fees are not counted.

Defi Saver Asset Management.revenue: Total fees paid are distributed to DefiSaver.
Defi Saver Asset Management.fees: Total fees paid by users for using DefiSaver services, excluding tokens sent back to the fee wallet from DefiSaver's own treasury wallets.

Definitive.revenue: Trading fees are split between Definitive and EDGE holders
Definitive.fees: User pays 0.25% - 0.85% fee on each trade. Majors and Stables have feeless trading.

Deluthium.revenue: All swap fees are retained by the protocol.
Deluthium.fees: Swap fees collected by the Deluthium settlement contract, taken from the feeAmount field of each QuoteSettled event.

DerpDEX.revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders

DexFi Aggregator.revenue: All collected fees are protocol revenue (no separate liquidity provider supply-side)
DexFi Aggregator.fees: Harvest fees comes to treasury contracts on each chain

Dinari.revenue: Trading fees (flat + variable) charged on buy and sell orders of tokenized stocks (dShares). All fees are revenue.
Dinari.fees: Trading fees (flat + variable) charged on buy and sell orders of tokenized stocks (dShares).

Domination Finance.revenue: The treasury's half of every maker and taker fee, from DevFeeCharged, plus the oracle fee from OracleFeeCharged. Liquidation margin is excluded, since it goes wholly to the vault.
Domination Finance.fees: Maker and taker fees on every open and close, liquidation margin, and the oracle fee charged once per price-requiring action. Both halves of each trading fee are read from the callback, the vault's and the treasury's. Funding is excluded: it moves between longs and shorts rather than to the protocol.

Donut.revenue: Treasury fees from each mining payment (15-20% of payments)
Donut.fees: Treasury fees (15-20%) + provider fees (0-5%) from mining payments.

DropSwap.revenue: Includes part of integrator fees retained by the protocol and part of integrator fees used to fund $DROP buybacks and burns.
DropSwap.fees: A 0.25% integrator fee is charged on the input token of every swap routed through DropSwap, recorded per chain in DropSwap's own database.

E3.revenue: A variable % of the trading fee is collected as Protocol Fees.
E3.fees: Net Trading fees paid is the Sum of fees sent to LP & Protocol Fees

EDEBASE.revenue: Revenue is calculated as 30% of the total fee.
EDEBASE.fees: All mint, burn, margin and liquidation and swap fees are collected

EISEN Finance.fees: Token trading fees paid by users.

ERC Burner.revenue: All fees collected by the protocol are considered revenue
ERC Burner.fees: User pays 2.5% of the total amount of tokens they are burning. Fees are calculated by tracking the fee amount from BurnSuccess events.

Echo.xyz.revenue: Platform fees collected by Echo protocol from each deal
Echo.xyz.fees: Platform fees collected by Echo protocol from each deal

Element NFT Marketplace.revenue: Share of trading fees to Element.
Element NFT Marketplace.fees: Fees paid by traders while trading NFTs on Element market.

ElfomoFi.revenue: Performance fees captured by the Elfomofi protocol.
ElfomoFi.fees: Total yield generated by Elfomofi vaults. Sum of yield distributed to LPs, performance fees captured by the protocol, and performance fees directed to curators. Each settlement reports a multi-day period at once, so its fees are distributed evenly forward over the following days.

EscapeHub Launchpad.fees: Bonding curve trading fees (1.20%) and fees on graduated Uniswap v4 pools taken by the EscapeHub hook (Base, Robinhood).

Euler V2.fees: Includes interest that is paid by the borrowers, protocol and curators fees, net of bad debt written off against vault lenders.

Exactly.revenue: Portion of borrow interest and early withdrawal fees directed to the protocol treasury based on the market treasury fee rate.
Exactly.fees: Total interest and fees paid by borrowers across variable (floating) and fixed-rate pools, early withdrawal penalties, and liquidation penalties.

Extra Finance Leverage Farming.revenue: All Leveraged Yield Farming fees are revenue and the protocol collects a 15% performance fee on borrowing interest profit
Extra Finance Leverage Farming.fees: Includes Leveraged Yield Farming fees like re-investment, borrowing, liquidation and price-range trigger fees plus the borrowing interest accrued

Extra Finance Xlend.revenue: Percentage of interest going to treasury

FLock.io.revenue: All FLOCK token fees collected by the protocol.
FLock.io.fees: All FLOCK token fees collected via CollectFee events from AI Arena and Delegation Pools, plus protocol/creator/antiSniper fees from Purchased events and launch creation fees from LaunchCreated events in the FOMO launchpad.

FOOM Cash.revenue: Protocol's retained fees: the 1% Generator fee, the 4% Investor fee, and fees earned by the official relayer.
FOOM Cash.fees: All daily protocol fees: a 1% Generator fee, a 4% Investor fee, and all relayer fees from both official and third-party relayers.

FWX DEX.revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders

Farcaster SoFi.revenue: All SoFi service fees are collected by the protocol as revenue.
Farcaster SoFi.fees: Service fees paid by users on Farcaster SoFi actions, received by the protocol.

FastJPEG.fees: Token trading and launching fees paid by users.

Ferzan Factory.revenue: Ferzan's share of the curve fee: 50%, less 10% to a referrer when one is set. On Solana, half of the DBC trading fee.
Ferzan Factory.fees: The 1% bonding curve trading fee on every Ferzan coin before it graduates (Meteora's DBC fee on Solana, including Meteora's protocol share).

Fibo.revenue: Fees retained by protocol treasury (100% of fees).
Fibo.fees: Protocol fee accruals on settled FIBO parimutuel rounds (treasury_flows fee_accrual via api.fibo.fun).

Fjord V2.revenue: Revenue is 100% fee of each swap which goes to treasury
Fjord V2.fees: Fees collected from user trading fees

Fledgo.revenue: Treasury allocation of each fee on an accrual basis; excludes creators, referrers and launched-token buybacks.
Fledgo.fees: Actual quote-asset swap charges emitted by the verified TaxHook FeesAccrued event. V1 launches charge no trading tax. No token mint allocation, gas, deposits, claim payments or buyback execution is counted as a new fee.

Flowlex.revenue: Commissions paid to the Flowlex treasury, read from token transfers from the LP manager to the treasury.
Flowlex.fees: Swap fees earned by Uniswap V3 positions opened through the Flowlex LP manager, including fees not collected yet, plus commissions charged on deposits, closes and rebalances.

Fluid DEX.revenue: Fluid takes a portion of swap fees.
Fluid DEX.fees: Total swap fees paid by users.

Fluid Lending.revenue: Percentage of interest going to treasury
Fluid Lending.fees: Interest paid by borrowers on Fluid + revenue share from JupLend

Folks Finance xChain.revenue: Protocol share of borrow interest (retention rate per pool).
Folks Finance xChain.fees: Borrow interest paid across all xChain hub pools.

FrostyFi.revenue: The protocol's share of every payment — operating, dev, protocol-owned-liquidity reserve and DAO buckets — i.e. gross payments minus third-party affiliate payouts.
FrostyFi.fees: Gross USDC product payments (subscriptions, pay-per-deploy, Architect builds, first-party agent income) entering the on-chain revenue splitter, summed from PaymentSplit events.

Furucombo.fees: Fees paid by users for using Furucombo services.

Fynd AMM.revenue: The owner fee that Fynd keeps from each swap fee (20% on current pools).
Fynd AMM.fees: Swap fees paid by traders. Fynd sets the fee of each swap, and the SignedExclusiveSwap extension takes it from the output token.

GLIF.revenue: 10% protocol fee on both pools. Filecoin: per docs.glif.io/en/for-liquidity-providers/glif-reward-mechanism-ifil iFIL holders earn 90% of SP borrow interest and the protocol treasury takes the remaining 10%, observable on events.glif.link/pool/0/fees. Base: on-chain PoolV2.treasuryFee() returns 0.1e18 = 10%, applied to each ICN node reward claim before LP rewards are restaked.
GLIF.fees: Interest and delegation rewards paid into the GLIF lending pools by Filecoin Storage Providers (FIL borrow APR) and Impossible Cloud Network node operators (ICN delegation rewards). Computed each day as LP yield from share-rate appreciation of iFIL / stICNT, grossed up by the 10% protocol treasury fee.

GMGN.revenue: Trading fees retained by GMGN after referral commissions. Solana referral is measured on-chain; EVM referral is estimated at the measured Solana referral rate (~16% of fees).
GMGN.fees: All trading fees paid by users while using GMGN AI bot (1% per trade), collected in both the native gas token and USDC, tracked via Dune. Solana = native-SOL + USDC inflows to the fee wallets; EVM = native gas-token + USDC inflows to the fee collector; Elysium (not on Dune) = the FeeCollected events of GMGN's router there.

Gains Network.revenue: Share of trading fees to protocol and token holders.

Galaxy Curation.fees: Total yields from deposited assets in all curated vaults.

Gamma.revenue: All yields are distributed to Gamma Protocol.
Gamma.fees: All yields are generated from liquidity providers.

Garden.revenue: 77% of swap fees go to the protocol treasury

Gate Swap Spot.revenue: The portion of swap fees retained by Gate Swap.
Gate Swap Spot.fees: Fees paid by users on Gate Swap routes, reported by the Gate Swap API for each hourly UTC window.

Gauntlet.fees: Total yields from deposited assets in all curated vaults.

GeckoTerminal.fees: All fees paid by users for token profile listing.

GhostMarket.fees: Users pay 2% fees on each trade

Giza.revenue: All performance fees are collected by the protocol.
Giza.fees: 10% performance fee charged on yields generated by the protocol.

Gloam.revenue: All cash-out fees go to the Gloam fee recipient.
Gloam.fees: A 0.5% fee on every cash-out from the Gloam shielded pool. Deposits and private payments are free.

GlueX.revenue: Revenue is calculated as the sum of routingFee for the old contract and the sum of protocolShare for the new contract.
GlueX.fees: Fees paid by users for swaps.

GoPlus Locker V2.revenue: All collected fees are considered as protocol revenue
GoPlus Locker V2.fees: All tokens received by the protocol's fee recipient addresses

Goon.revenue: The USD share of swap fees, minus whatever Uniswap's protocol fee switch (read live per pool via slot0().feeProtocol) diverts to Uniswap itself.
Goon.fees: Uniswap V3 swap fees generated by Goon-launched pools (pools with under $100 TVL are excluded as dust).

Grove Finance.fees: Includes all the yields earned by allocating assets into various defi protocols

Gully Core.revenue: Gully Core's share of swap fees, all routing fees, and Gully Core's share of launch trade fees, creator taxes and launch fees, as set on-chain for each pool and launch.
Gully Core.fees: Swap fees paid by traders in Gully Core pools, the fee Gully Core's router charges on trades it sends to other DEXs, and the trade fees, creator taxes and launch fees paid on tokens launched through Gully Core's launchpad.

Haiku.fees: All fees paid by users for swap and bridge tokens via Haiku.

Hanji Protocol.revenue: admin_commission_rate share of commission, plus the marketmaker's share when the marketmaker equals the administrator
Hanji Protocol.fees: Taker fee on aggressive orders plus maker commission on resting orders, in tokenY

Hash PayLink.revenue: All tracked fees are collected by the Hash PayLink treasury.
Hash PayLink.fees: Hash PayLink charges a 0.2% platform fee on successful payment settlement. Sponsored smart-wallet payments may also route a small USDC gas recovery amount to the treasury in the same settlement.

Hashlock Markets.revenue: All protocol fees (Fees paid by the taker when a leg is funded) go to the Hashlock Markets treasury.
Hashlock Markets.fees: Protocol fee paid by the taker when a leg is funded, on top of the escrowed amount (FeeCollected on EVM and TRON, the fee field of Funded on Solana). It is not refunded.

Hedgey.revenue: Fees paid by users using payment services.
Hedgey.fees: Fees paid by users using payment services.

Helio.revenue: Total fees paid by users, excluding txs on Solana in which the fee account also sends tokens.
Helio.fees: Total fees paid by users. On Solana, tokens the fee account receives in txs where it also sends tokens (its own SOL to USDC swaps) are not counted.

HookOS.revenue: Total fees minus the supply-side share paid to token creators and hook authors.
HookOS.fees: Every fee HookOS charges, read from the contracts' own fee events. Native fees routed through FeeRouter are attributed to the module that paid them: bonding-curve trades, token launches, hook registrations, arena battles and tournaments. Added to that are the fees that never touch FeeRouter and are read at source: creator fees, hook-author revenue (HookRevenueVault), HookOS-V3 launch LP fees on all seven chains (HookOSV3FeeVault), presale raise and creation fees (PresaleVault, the one module live on every chain), bot trading fees (BotTradeRouter), LP fees of graduated Uniswap-v4 positions (LPFeeSplitter), the HookOS cut of v4 swaps taken by the graduation and Quick Launch hooks, the $HOOK v4 pool tax (HookWethTax) and the tokenized-stock pool tax (StockTaxHook).

Hop Protocol.fees: Fees paid by users for bridging tokens via Hop.

HorizonDEX.revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders

Hot Take.revenue: The protocol fee share of claims, paid to the protocol fee collector.
Hot Take.fees: Protocol fee plus judge fee, both charged on the pot when the winner claims.

House of Joshi.revenue: All House swap fees are retained by the protocol; there is no supply-side fee allocation.
House of Joshi.fees: The 1% House fee paid by users on swaps executed through HojswapRouterV2, using the exact feeAmount emitted for each trade.

Human Passport.revenue: All verification fees collected by the Gitcoin protocol
Human Passport.fees: Verification fees (~$2 USD in native ETH per attestation) paid when users call verifyAndAttest on GitcoinVerifier contracts to bring Gitcoin Passport data onchain

Hydrex Integral.revenue: Protocol revenue from DEX fees (to holders), option exercises (to Strategic Protocol Reserve/treasury), and Omni Liquidity fees (to holders). External bribes are tracked separately in BribesRevenue.
Hydrex Integral.fees: Total fees from DEX fees, option exercises, Omni Liquidity fees, and external bribes.

Hydrometer Finance.revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders

HyperDex Aggregator.revenue: All of these fees go to HyperDex.
HyperDex Aggregator.fees: The 0.25% integrator fee HyperDex charges on every swap, bridge and basket order routed through LI.FI: the FeesForwarded leg paid to HyperDex in a transaction whose LI.FI event carries integrator "hyperdex" (Robinhood Chain and Solana: the integrator share of each transfer's fee from LI.FI's analytics API, in USD); HyperDex's leg of its client fee on Fynd swaps, from the TychoRouter FeesTaken event; and HyperDex's fee on RAVN, Velora, Hinkal and CoW swaps, at its fee rate on each completed swap in HyperDex's own swap record (https://hyperdex.app/api/defillama), at the swap's dollar amount when sent.

HyperFX.revenue: The 0.05% protocol fee, retained by the gateway.
HyperFX.fees: 0.05% protocol fee deducted from order inputs at placement.

Hyperlane.revenue: Gross IGP payments to Hyperlane-published relayer contracts.
Hyperlane.fees: User-paid Hyperlane interchain gas payments from InterchainGasPaymaster GasPayment events.

IPOR Fusion.revenue: The IPOR DAO share of performance and management fees, as configured in each vault FeeManager.
IPOR Fusion.fees: Gross yield earned by PlasmaVault depositors plus all fees charged by the vaults (performance, management and deposit fees), measured from the fee shares actually minted on-chain.

Impermax V2.revenue: Percentage of interest going to treasury, based on each lending pool's reserve factor.
Impermax V2.fees: Fees is the interest rate paid by borrowers

Impermax V3.revenue: Percentage of interest going to treasury, based on each lending pool's reserve factor.
Impermax V3.fees: Fees is the interest rate paid by borrowers

Index Coop.revenue: Fees retained by the Index Coop protocol, including manager and protocol portions.
Index Coop.fees: Streaming fees and issuance/redemption fees paid by users.

Infinex Spot.revenue: All collected swap fees accrue to Infinex.
Infinex Spot.fees: All tokens routed to Infinex swap fee collectors across supported chains (USD-converted via Allium).

Infinite Trading Protocol.revenue: Portion of auto compounder fees and 90% of cbEGGS fees are sent to the infinite fee address as revenue.
Infinite Trading Protocol.fees: Total fees collected from auto compounder vaults and user deposits/withdrawals on the cbEGGS contract.

InfinityName.revenue: Registration fees collected by the protocol's feeRecipient address minus referral commissions
InfinityName.fees: Domain registration fees paid by users in native tokens (includes protocol fees + referral commissions)

IntentX.revenue: All the trading fees are revenue
IntentX.fees: Perp trading fees paid by users

Interface Social.fees: All fees paid by users for using Interface App.

JOJO.revenue: Total trading fees paid by users.
JOJO.fees: Total trading fees paid by users.

Javsphere.fees: LeverageX traders paying fees for open trades.

Jeton.fees: Fees paid by users for trading and bridging.

Jumper Bridge Aggregator.revenue: All platform fees are kept by Jumper.
Jumper Bridge Aggregator.fees: Jumper platform fees (0-5 bps depending on the assets) paid by users on bridges.

Jumper DEX Aggregator.revenue: All platform fees are kept by Jumper.
Jumper DEX Aggregator.fees: Jumper platform fees (0-5 bps depending on the assets) paid by users on swaps.

KAIO.revenue: Management fees are counted as protocol revenue.
KAIO.fees: Estimated daily management fees from KAIO's current TVL and the annual fund fee rates listed on RWA.xyz.

KPK.revenue: Curator's cut: Euler 5% interestFee on KPK's underlying markets + 50% of Gearbox TreasurySplitter inflows. Morpho is excluded (KPK charges a 0% curator fee on Morpho).
KPK.fees: Gross interest/yield from KPK-curated Morpho and Euler vaults, plus realized Gearbox TreasurySplitter inflows.

Kaito Capital Launchpad.revenue: All launchpad fees collected by Kaito (2.5% USDC + 2.5% project tokens).
Kaito Capital Launchpad.fees: 5% fee on each sale's final raise: 2.5% in USDC + 2.5% in project tokens (valued at the sale).

Kasu.revenue: Performance fees captured within the Kasu system: the sum of the protocol-receiver share (ProtocolRevenue) and the rKSU-holder share (HoldersRevenue). Neither is paid to external suppliers.
Kasu.fees: Gross interest paid by borrowers across Kasu lending pools (performance fees + lender share). Interest accrued during each epoch is spread evenly across the epoch's days.

Kelp.revenue: Protocol fees from rsETH (on-chain protocol fee on staking rewards), agETH management fees (2%), hgETH management fees (1.5%), and hgETH performance fees (20% of positive rate delta).
Kelp.fees: Sum of total staking rewards from rsETH (ETH staking rewards + EIGEN rewards), agETH management fees, and hgETH management/performance fees.

Kerberus.fees: Fees paid by users for using Kerberus services.

KiloEx.revenue: 70% of trading fees retained by the protocol

KyberSwap Aggregator.revenue: All collected aggregator fees retained by KyberSwap.
KyberSwap Aggregator.fees: Aggregator fees retained by KyberSwap on routed swaps. Pulled from both ERC20 Transfer events into the fee collector and from native gas-token internal transfers on chains where the indexer covers them.

KyberSwap Elastic.revenue: Currently 100% of the dao rewards (10% of the collected fees) goes to all voters (KNC stakers)
KyberSwap Elastic.fees: Each pool can have different fees set from the following tires: 0.008%, 0.01%, 0.04%, 0.3% and 1%

LI.FI Bridge Aggregator.revenue: Share of fees kept by LI.FI.
LI.FI Bridge Aggregator.fees: All fees paid by users on LI.FI bridges, including integrator fees.

LI.FI DEX Aggregator.revenue: Share of fees kept by LI.FI.
LI.FI DEX Aggregator.fees: All fees paid by users on LI.FI swaps, including integrator fees.

Lagoon.revenue: Portion of performance and management fees to Lagoon protocol.
Lagoon.fees: Total yield to suppliers + fees share to Lagoon protocol + fees share to vault curators.

Land Bid.revenue: For V2, includes protocol revenue plus holders revenue, equal to 15% of Conquer.price and LP fees earned by protocol-owned/locked Uniswap V3 liquidity. Historical V1 revenue is kept under the previous adapter methodology.
Land Bid.fees: For V2, includes protocol revenue plus holders revenue, equal to 15% of Conquer.price and LP fees earned by protocol-owned/locked Uniswap V3 liquidity. Historical V1 data is kept under the previous adapter methodology.

Latch Protocol.revenue: What reaches the protocol, counted when the fee is taken: the protocol fee each Swap event carries; the protocol's share of a launch pool's liquidity fees under the pool's permanent LP lock split, only where the locks provably hold all of the pool's liquidity; and the protocol's share of the creator tax and guard trade fee under the split the guard stores for that pool. A split that cannot be read is never guessed: that amount is left out of Revenue.
Latch Protocol.fees: Everything traders pay on a swap: the pool's swap fee from the Swap event (protocol fee included), plus what a Latch launch pool's guard takes itself - the creator tax, and on newer launch guards the guard's part of the trade fee - read from the guard's TaxTaken and FeeTaken events. Only Latch's own launch guards are read.

Layer3.revenue: The portion of the fees retained by the protocol
Layer3.fees: Fees paid by users when minting Cube NFTs on Layer3

LayerZero V1.revenue: ZRO protocol fees moved from UltraLightNodeV2 to the LayerZero V1 Treasury contract via WithdrawZRO. Historically the V1 protocol take rate has been ~0, so this value is typically negligible. Tokens flow to the Foundation treasury and are not burnt by the contract.
LayerZero V1.fees: Native and ZRO fees paid by users for cross-chain messages routed through the LayerZero V1 endpoint, summed from WithdrawNative and WithdrawZRO events on UltraLightNodeV2 contracts across supported chains. Withdrawals lag the actual send() events by the worker/treasury withdrawal cadence; totals converge over time.

LayerZero V2.revenue: ZRO buybacks funded by Stargate ecosystem allocation routed to LayerZero Foundation. LayerZero takes a 0% protocol take rate on messaging fees.
LayerZero V2.fees: Native token fees paid by users for cross-chain messaging, summed from ExecutorFeePaid and DVNFeePaid events on SendUln302 (V2 default) and SendUln301 (V1-compat through V2 endpoints) across supported chains.

Lazy Summer Protocol.revenue: 30% of tips flow to the DAO treasury and SUMR stakers.
Lazy Summer Protocol.fees: TipAccrued share amounts emitted by active FleetCommanders, converted to vault assets via convertToAssets and summed per underlying asset token.

LienFi.revenue: Includes 2% property NFT sale fees and 10% of interest earned from property NFTs.
LienFi.fees: Includes 2% property NFT sale fees and interest earned from property NFTs.

LilSwap Bridge Aggregator.revenue: Bridge fees retained by LilSwap after partner share.
LilSwap Bridge Aggregator.fees: Bridge fees paid by users on completed transfers.

LilSwap DEX Aggregator.revenue: Swap fees retained by LilSwap after partner share.
LilSwap DEX Aggregator.fees: Swap fees paid by users, including LilSwap's explicit fee and surplus share.

Limitless Exchange.revenue: Trading fees left over after the daily payouts to makers, liquidity providers and market creators
Limitless Exchange.fees: Trading fees paid by takers. Only takers pay: the orderbook charges 0.40%-3.00% on buys and 0.42%-1.50% on sells depending on the price, and maker fees are refunded in full. AMM markets charge a flat 0.40%.

Liquid Protocol LaunchPad.revenue: 50% of the deployment fees go to the protocol
Liquid Protocol LaunchPad.fees: Includes 0.2% deployment fee collected by the Liquid Factory contract on Base

Lockcurve.revenue: 30% of every trading fee and every launch fee, sent to the Lockcurve treasury.
Lockcurve.fees: 1% of every trade on the bonding curve and in the graduated Uniswap v4 pools, plus the flat USDC fee paid to launch a coin.

Lombard Vaults.revenue: Performance fees and platform fees distributed to Lombard Protocol.
Lombard Vaults.fees: Total yields are generated by staking assets in DeFi strategies (Aave, Pendle, Uniswap, etc).

Looter.revenue: Trading fees are collected by Looter protocol.
Looter.fees: All trading fees paid by users while using Looter bot.

Lunar Finance Aggregator.revenue: Protocol fees retained by Lunar Finance.
Lunar Finance Aggregator.fees: User-paid fees on underlying DEX protocols plus Lunar platform fees where applicable.

Lunar Finance Bridge Aggregator.revenue: Protocol fees retained by Lunar Finance.
Lunar Finance Bridge Aggregator.fees: User-paid bridge fees including underlying provider fees.

Lunarbase.revenue: The protocol's cut: the treasury share of the legacy pool's fee (currently 0). Dark-pool spreads go to the market makers that provide inventory, not the protocol.
Lunarbase.fees: The spread charged on each swap.

MEV-X Homelander.revenue: The protocol's share of the captured arbitrage, taken from the distributor's own share config as it stood at the block of each capture. Nothing of the swap fee is the protocol's, and the captures donated straight to liquidity providers leave it nothing either.
MEV-X Homelander.fees: Two things, and they are different money, and only the first of them is paid by anyone: it is reported as the user fee as well. First, the fee a trader paid on a swap in a pool the plugin runs in, at the rate the plugin set for that swap; the plugin takes no share of that fee, so nothing of it is charged to the user on the protocol's behalf. Second, the arbitrage the plugin realised inside the pool and paid out, read from the ProfitDistributed event where a deployment settles through a distributor and from the donatedToLps leg of ProfitShared where the plugin pays the pool's liquidity providers directly.

Maestro.revenue: Trading fees kept by Maestro protocol after referral rewards.
Maestro.fees: All trading fees paid by users while using Maestro bot.

Makina.revenue: Makina treasury share of the management and performance fees.
Makina.fees: Yield earned by Makina machine depositors, plus the management and performance fees minted by machines.

Mamo.revenue: Aerodrome LP fees distributed to MAMO stakers.
Mamo.fees: Aerodrome LP fees distributed to MAMO stakers.

MarkIt.revenue: 2% trading fees collected on every bet.
MarkIt.fees: LP fee ~1% base ± skew, protocol fee 2%) from each BetPlaced event.

Matcha.revenue: all fees are collected by matcha
Matcha.fees: Matcha takes a 0.05% - 0.25% fee on certain pairs for matcha auto trades.

Maverick V1.revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders
Maverick V1.fees: Fees generated on each swap at a rate set by the pool.

Maverick V2.revenue: The protocol's cut of the swap fee, set per pool. Every pool is currently set to 0%, so this is zero.
Maverick V2.fees: Swap fee charged on the amount paid into each pool, at the rate that pool sets for the traded direction.

Mayan DEX Aggregator.revenue: Fees are 10 basis points (0.1%) of the outbound bridge volume through Mayan WH Swap on each chain. Only source chain transactions pay fees.
Mayan DEX Aggregator.fees: Fees are 10 basis points (0.1%) of the outbound bridge volume through Mayan WH Swap on each chain. Only source chain transactions pay fees.

MemeMarket.revenue: All fees are collected by the protocol.
MemeMarket.fees: Fees from minting (1%) and burning (1.5%) tokens on MemeMarket bonding curves.

MemeWe.Club.fees: Tokens trading and launching fees paid by users.

MetaLeX.revenue: 100% of this 0.3% service fee is retained by MetaLeX as revenue.
MetaLeX.fees: Tracks the 0.3% service fee charged by MetaLeX when fundraising escrows are finalized.

MetaMask Wallet.revenue: Fees collected by Metamask paid by users for trading, swapping, bridging in Metamask wallet.
MetaMask Wallet.fees: All fees paid by users for trading, swapping, bridging in Metamask wallet.

Metronome Synth.revenue: All synth interest, swap fees, AMO profits, LP fees and LP rewards earned by the Metronome treasury.
Metronome Synth.fees: Synth interest and swap fees minted to the Metronome treasury, AMO harvest profits, MetBasis LP fees, other LP rewards (AERO/xAERO/VELO/KITE/CRV/OETH/FXN), and UniV3 and Aero LP fees on treasury-owned positions.

Midas RWA.revenue: Redemption and deposit fees collected by Midas from both instant and request-based operations. Management and performance fees are deducted before NAV publication.
Midas RWA.fees: Net yield accrued to mToken holders (NAV appreciation) plus redemption and deposit fees (instant + request-based) charged by the protocol.

MineBean.revenue: All extracted fees (admin + vault) are protocol revenue.
MineBean.fees: Fees extracted per round: 1% admin fee on totalDeployed, 1% admin fee on losers pool, and 10% vault fee on losers pool after admin. Variable effective rate depending on winner/loser ratio.

MineLoot.revenue: All extracted fees (admin + vault) are protocol revenue.
MineLoot.fees: Fees extracted per round: 1% admin fee on totalDeployed, 1% admin fee on losers pool, and 10% vault fee on losers pool after admin. Variable effective rate depending on winner/loser ratio.

MiroShark Token.revenue: 57% of swap fees routed to MiroShark, per the on-chain beneficiary split read from the multicurve initializer.
MiroShark Token.fees: Dynamic swap fee (1.2% steady-state) paid by users trading on the WETH/MiroShark Uniswap v4 pool on Base. Liquidity is protocol-owned multicurve positions, there are no third-party LPs.

MiroShark x402 API.revenue: All API fees accrue to MiroShark — there is no supply side and facilitators charge no on-chain cut.
MiroShark x402 API.fees: API usage fees paid by users of the x402.miroshark.xyz simulation API ($1.00 USDC per simulation run), settled on Base via x402 (gasless EIP-3009 USDC transfers submitted by x402 facilitators).

MoneyFi V1.revenue: Revenue share from total fees going to treasury
MoneyFi V1.fees: Total fees generated by the MoneyFi protocol

Moonwell Vaults.fees: Total yields from deposited assets in all curated vaults.

Morpho Blue.fees: Total borrow interest paid by borrowers + liquidation bonues earned by liquidators.

Morpho Midnight.revenue: Protocol fees kept by Morpho: the settlement fee (taker-paid spread on each trade) plus the continuous fee accrued on new lender credit. Both are disabled at launch, so Revenue is currently 0.
Morpho Midnight.fees: Total borrow interest paid by borrowers: for every trade, the face value of the debt (units) minus the loan tokens the borrower received (sellerAssets), i.e. the fixed-rate discount locked in at execution.

Muscadine.fees: Total yields from deposited assets in all curated vaults.

Musical Chairs.revenue: Commission from total deposits post referral bonuses.

Mycelia Signal.revenue: All USDC paid for Mycelia oracle API calls, kept by the protocol. There is no supply-side, LP, integrator, or token-holder revenue split.
Mycelia Signal.fees: USDC payments received for Mycelia oracle API calls on Base. Counts x402 per-call payments settled to the direct settlement wallet (0xD593832Ce9C2B13B192ba50B55dd9AF44e96700d) and Orbis marketplace payouts, which are 80% of the revenue from Orbis-mediated traffic (Orbis retains 20% as a facilitator fee). Other USDC sent to the wallets, such as fund movements and internal transfers between Mycelia wallets, is excluded.

NARA Protocol.revenue: Net protocol fees retained across NARAFeeVaultV5 (POL + committed holder share), NARAPositionSaleV5 and NARARewardIngressV5 (committed holder share), and CryptoSLIP treasury share.
NARA Protocol.fees: Swap fees realized by NARALiquidityHookV5, Protocol-Owned Liquidity (POL) LP fees booked into NARAFeeVaultV5, 5.00% secondary position sale fees on NARAPositionSaleV5, external EIP-2981 royalties received by NARARewardIngressV5, and 0.50% slip issuance fees on CryptoSLIP vaults. Zero management or performance fees are charged.

NICKEL.revenue: All extracted fees (admin + vault) are protocol revenue.
NICKEL.fees: Fees extracted per round: 1% admin fee on totalDeployed, 1% admin fee on losers pool, and 10% vault fee on losers pool after admin. Variable effective rate depending on winner/loser ratio.

Nabla Finance.revenue: The share of each swap fee kept by the protocol, allocated to the Nabla DAO Treasury.
Nabla Finance.fees: Users pay between 0.01% and 0.1% fees on each swap.

Nami.revenue: Swap fees of gauged pools, paid to Nami token holders: 90% to veNAMI voters and 10% to ogNAMI stakers.
Nami.fees: Swap fees paid by traders, at the dynamic fee the Nami plugin sets for each swap.

Napier.revenue: Protocol/DAO share of PT/YT fees and of the TokiHook swap fee reserve, based on the Curator-Protocol fee split ratio.
Napier.fees: Total fees paid by users: AMM swap fees (Napier Curve pools and TokiHook pools, the whole swap fee including the part reserved for curators and protocol) and PT/YT fees (issuance, redemption, performance). PT/YT fee events fire on yield collection, not daily.

Native Credit Pool.revenue: The slice of borrow interest Native reserves for itself plus any widget fee it collects. Both are zero today: the reserve rate is set to 0 and no widget fees are being charged.
Native Credit Pool.fees: Interest market makers pay to borrow from Native credit pools, plus the widget fee a front-end can add to a swap. Native takes nothing on the swap itself - a market maker earns from the price it quotes, so that is not counted here.

Nether.Fi.revenue: Revenue is 30% of all collected fees, which goes to NFI and esNFI stakers
Nether.Fi.fees: Open/Close position: 0.1% | Swap: 0.2% to 0.8% | Mint and Burn: 0% to 0.85% (based on tokens balance in the pool) | Borrow Fee: `(assets borrowed) / (total assets in pool) * 0.01%`

NodeOps.fees: Payment made by the users, sum totalOrderAmount from OrderRecorded events.

Nullmask.revenue: 0.5% protocol fee on shielded pool deposits and 0.5% on withdrawals (Ethereum, Base, BNB Chain, Robinhood Chain, Avalanche, Arbitrum, Monad, Solana), deposit check fees on Solana, plus ZEC rewards received by the Nullmask team wallet from MASK token holder distributions (Solana).
Nullmask.fees: 0.5% protocol fee on shielded pool deposits and 0.5% on withdrawals (Ethereum, Base, BNB Chain, Robinhood Chain, Avalanche, Arbitrum, Monad, Solana), deposit check fees on Solana, plus ZEC rewards received by the Nullmask team wallet from MASK token holder distributions (Solana).

ODOS.revenue: Revenue is equal to the fees collected.
ODOS.fees: All fees paid by users for using Odos services.

OKX Swap.revenue: Commissions paid to OKX's own fee accounts, OKX's DEX interface fee and its 20% share of DEX API partner fees, and the positive slippage paid to those accounts.
OKX Swap.fees: Total comission fees from every trade, plus the positive slippage the routers take from swaps.

Odyssey Finance.fees: Includes all protocol fees from Odyssey.

Olympus DAO.revenue: Sum of all protocol revenue streams - as a reserve currency protocol, all revenue strengthens the treasury backing OHM
Olympus DAO.fees: Total revenue from all protocol sources across chains: sUSDS/sUSDe treasury yield, CD Facility yield, CD Lending interest, POL fees, and Berachain POL operations (iBGT DEX sales, iBERA staking yield, oBERO exercise proceeds, BERA/iBERA sales). Cooler Loan interest is tracked separately in the cooler-loans adapter.

Omni Exchange V2.revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders

OmniHub.fees: Mint and Publish NFT fees are paid by users

OnOne.revenue: The protocol lane of each swap fee, credited to the OnOne treasury, plus the full launch fee. On Solana, the platform's share of the LP fee (40% when the creator share is 60%). The site's 1% routing fee is not included, because the router does not emit it on its own.
OnOne.fees: Quote-token fees taken by the OnOne launch hook on each swap, plus the native coin paid to launch a coin. On Solana, the LP fee earned by the OnOne Meteora pool (Meteora's own protocol cut is left on Meteora's listing). The 1% fee on swaps routed through the OnOne site is taken inside the Uniswap router and has no separate event, so it is not estimated here.

OpenEden USDO.revenue: Mint/redeem USDO fees and 0.3% annual is charged by the Investment Manager.
OpenEden USDO.fees: All fees from users mint/redeem USDO, yields and management fees from backing assets.

Ophis.revenue: Fees retained by Ophis. Ophis-operated chains retain the full fee; on CoW-hosted chains this is net of CoW Protocol's 25% partner-fee share. Unichain and OP Mainnet are temporarily excluded while their reporting sources are unavailable.
Ophis.fees: Ophis fees assessed on successfully settled Ophis-attributed fills, including the 1 bp base fee and capped price-improvement capture. Values come from Ophis' settlement-fill ledger, are bucketed by settlement date, and are valued in USD by the reporting indexer. Unichain and OP Mainnet are temporarily excluded while their reporting sources are unavailable.

Origin Ether.revenue: Per-product yield × trusteeFeeBps read on-chain from each vault (OETH and superOETHb both 20%).
Origin Ether.fees: Yield earned by Origin Ether (OETH) vault strategies on Ethereum and Super OETH (superOETHb) on Base, before Origin's performance fee.

Overtime.revenue: Fees minus sportsbook and casino referral fees, all kept by the Overtime treasury, which has been the only sportsbook liquidity provider since 2026-07-21 (OIP-265) and has always funded the casino and Speed Markets bankrolls. Speed Markets referral fees are not tracked and are not deducted.
Overtime.fees: What bettors lost to the house on settled sportsbook, casino and Speed Markets bets (stakes minus payouts, less winnings paid on protocol-funded free bets), negative when bettors win more than they lose; before 2026-07-21, while the sportsbook pools were shared with external liquidity providers, the sportsbook only counts its SafeBox trading fee and the SafeBox share of profitable pool rounds.

OwlOrderFi.revenue: All the protocol fees deducted from the output token of each executed order. The router has no liquidity providers, so nothing is shared out.
OwlOrderFi.fees: Protocol fee deducted from the output token of each executed order. The rate is signed by the maker as part of the order and capped on-chain at 1%.

P2P.me.revenue: Protocol captures the spread between buyer and seller prices applied to matched volume.
P2P.me.fees: Revenue from the spread between buy and sell prices on the P2P ramping platform.

PRED.revenue: All recorded on-chain trade fees accrue to the protocol for the current deployment.
PRED.fees: Trading fees paid by users on Pred prediction-market trades on Base, valued at execution prices; excludes later transfers and redemptions of collected fees.

PRIZM.revenue: All platform fees (0.85% on swaps + 0.33% on staking, lending and liquidity actions) accrue to the protocol; there are no referral or cashback payouts.
PRIZM.fees: Platform fees paid by PRIZM users: 0.85% on swaps routed through Jupiter, collected in the output mint via Jupiter referral fee accounts, and 0.33% on staking, lending and liquidity actions, transferred to the PRIZM fee wallet atomically with the action.

PagCrypto.revenue: Revenue represents fees collected by PagFinance from fiat to crypto settlements.
PagCrypto.fees: Transaction fees paid by users for fiat to crypto settlements.

PancakeSwap AMM.revenue: All revenue generated comes from user fees.
PancakeSwap AMM.fees: All fees comes from the user.

PancakeSwap AMM V3.revenue: Pancakeswap collects amount of swap fees for Treasury and buy back CAKE.
PancakeSwap AMM V3.fees: Total trading fees - sum of LP fees and protocol fees. LP fees vary by pool type (0.25% for most pools, with some special pools having different rates). Protocol fees are 0.05% for most pools.

PancakeSwap Infinity.revenue: Share of swap fees to protocol and holders.
PancakeSwap Infinity.fees: Total swap fees paid by users.

Pangolins.fees: Total yields from deposited assets in all curated vaults.

Parallel Protocol V3.revenue: DAO Treasury share of net surplus accrual, on both lines: 9% before June 1, 2026, and 10% thereafter (the 1% previously paid to Angle Labs is redistributed to the DAO after the BUSL 1.1 license expires).
Parallel Protocol V3.fees: Daily change in protocol net surplus (total collateral value minus USDp outstanding), in two lines: the mint, burn and redeem fees paid that day, computed from the Parallelizer's Swap and Redeemed events at the rates the contract applies (read on-chain), and the yield from the yield-bearing collateral, which is the rest of the surplus change.

Peapods Finance.revenue: Revenue is collected in a wide variety of different tokens and converted to blue chip assets to be kept as protocol revenue (40%) and converted to PEAS for holders revenue (60%).
Peapods Finance.fees: Includes interest paid, auto-compounding LP yields, liquidation proceeds, and LVF open/close actions.

PeddleQuest.revenue: All fees (quest creation, deposit, unclaimed, promotion and badge) are kept by the protocol. Quest rewards themselves go to winners and are not counted as fees or revenue.
PeddleQuest.fees: Everything PeddleQuest charges: the fee quest creators pay on top of the reward pool they deposit, the flat quest creation fee, the protocol's share of rewards that winners did not claim before the deadline, payments for trending and banner promotion slots, and the fee users pay to mint an optional completion badge.

Peddles.revenue: The protocol's share of each swap fee and of the opening fee, plus all launch fees and all Terminal and trade bot fees.
Peddles.fees: Everything users pay: the fee charged on each swap of a launched token, the higher fee charged in the first minutes after a launch, the fee to create a launch, and the fee the Peddles Terminal and trade bot add to a swap.

Peer.fees: Positive realized maker spread on fulfilled Peer intents, measured against the oracle rate at settlement. Maker-funded discounts (negative spread) are excluded. Peer charges no separate platform or protocol fee.

Pendle V2.revenue: Sum of 5% fee from all yield + points accrued and 80% trading fees + sPENDLE instant-exit fees + what PT Looper users pay the treasury.
Pendle V2.fees: Total yield from deposited assets + trading fees paid by yield traders + sPENDLE instant-exit fees + what PT Looper users pay the treasury.

Phantom Wallet.fees: All fees paid by users for swapping, bridging in Phantom wallet.

Pheasant Network.fees: Total fees paid by users for bridge and swap txs.

PinkSale.revenue: All fees are collected by PinkSale protocol.
PinkSale.fees: All fees paid by users by using PinkSale services.

Pizza City.revenue: 15% of auction pot sent to Treasury for permanent LP
Pizza City.fees: 15% of auction pot sent to Treasury for permanent LP

Pocket Universe Extension.revenue: All fess paid by users while use extension.
Pocket Universe Extension.fees: All fess paid by users while use extension.

Polter Finance.fees: lockers' revenue = stakers' revenue + 50% penalty from early exit

PoolTogether V5.revenue: Users in POOL vaults get a % of all prize odds (typically range from 4%-12%)
PoolTogether V5.fees: All the yields earned by pooltogether's assets

Portal.fees: Total fees paid by users or Protocols for using Wormhole Relayers, Executions, CCTP and Cross chain message fees.

PrimeFi.revenue: Percentage of interest going to treasury

Primus.revenue: The portion of verification fees paid to Primus.
Primus.fees: Native-token fees paid by users for completed Primus verification reports.

Printr.revenue: 75% of trading fees: team (10%), protocol-controlled memecoin reserve (25%), and buyback (40%).
Printr.fees: Printr charges a 1% fee on all bonding curve swaps.

Privacy Cash.revenue: All of it. Privacy Cash has no liquidity providers, lenders or stakers to pay, so nothing is deducted from fees.
Privacy Cash.fees: The fee taken when a user moves funds out of a shielded pool - a withdrawal, a swap or a bridge transfer - read as the exact amount the pool paid Privacy Cash rather than a modelled rate. The published schedule is 0.35% of the amount, plus a flat charge that covers relaying the transaction: 0.006 SOL on Solana (0.008 SOL for swaps), 0.00025 ETH on Base, and a variable network-based charge on Ethereum. Deposits are free. Jupiter swap fees and the 0.1% NEAR bridging fee are paid to those protocols, not to Privacy Cash, and are not counted here.

Privacy Pools V2.revenue: Deposit vetting fees kept by the protocol plus the protocol's feeBps share (20%) of the Aave yield.
Privacy Pools V2.fees: Deposit vetting fees, relayer fees taken out of relayed withdrawals (plain, yield-share and withdraw-and-swap routes), and the full Aave v3 yield earned on the ppUSDC / ppUSDT / ppETH yield shares.

PriveX.revenue: All platform fees collected represent protocol revenue
PriveX.fees: Platform fees collected by PriveX from derivatives trading activities

PumpBox.revenue: USDC paid by users to request blind box openings plus PumpDaily subscriptions, net of buyback spends.
