PumpBox.fees: USDC paid by users to request blind box openings plus PumpDaily subscriptions, net of buyback spends.

Pyth Core.revenue: All update fees accrue to the Pyth protocol treasury.
Pyth Core.fees: Fees paid by users to update Pyth price feeds on-chain. Fee amounts per chain are set by Pyth DAO governance via singleUpdateFeeInWei() on each contract.

Pyth Entropy.revenue: Protocol fees collected by Pyth DAO treasury per randomness request.
Pyth Entropy.fees: Total fees paid per Entropy randomness request. Fee = Provider fee (dynamic, covers gas) + Protocol fee (set by Pyth DAO governance).

QuickPerps.revenue: Affiliate fees on Base (SYMMIO) and builder fees on Falkor (Orderly) earned by QuickSwap.
QuickPerps.fees: Affiliate fees on Base (SYMMIO) and builder fees on Falkor (Orderly) earned by QuickSwap.

Quickswap Dex.revenue: Protocol takes 16.66% of collected fees (0.05% of swap volume).
Quickswap Dex.fees: 0.3% of each swap is collected as trading fees

RIP.FUN.revenue: All fees (cash primary sales, opening fees, marketplace commissions, and first-party marketplace and auction proceeds, net of purchase refunds and completed external inventory buybacks) accrue to RIP.FUN.
RIP.FUN.fees: Cash primary sales and opening fees, marketplace commissions, and first-party marketplace and auction proceeds, net of purchase refunds and completed external inventory buybacks. Voucher-funded purchases and protocol-owned inventory recycling are excluded.

Rabby Wallet.fees: All fees paid by users for swapping, bridging in Rabby wallet.

Radiant V2.revenue: All platform fees are kept by the protocol (split between the operationExpenses treasury and dLP lockers).
Radiant V2.fees: Platform fees collected by Radiant (reserve-factor cut of borrow interest) and routed through MiddleFeeDistribution.

Raflux.revenue: Pack purchases minus USDC returned to players, kept by Raflux. No share goes to LPs, referrers or token holders.
Raflux.fees: Pack purchases minus USDC returned to players: refunds of cancelled pulls, card cash-outs, sell-backs, USDC prizes and reimbursed card shipments. This is the 10% fee Raflux keeps when a card is exchanged for USDC plus the game result of pulls, so it is negative on days when players win more than they pay.

Rainbow Token Launchpad.fees: Rainbow receives 50% of the 0.2% deployment fee collected by the Liquid Factory contract on Base

Rainbow Wallet.revenue: 0.85% revenue from trading volume, plus the bridge relaying fee charged on each bridge transfer
Rainbow Wallet.fees: 0.85% fees from trading volume, plus the bridge relaying fee charged on each bridge transfer

Rango.fees: Platform fees, affiliate fees and destination executor fees charged by Rango on swaps and cross-chain transfers. On Solana, where there is no fee event to split, net inflows to the fee collector are attributed to affiliate fees to match the dominant fee share on EVM.

Re.revenue: Fees recorded in the fee vault
Re.fees: Yield accrued by reUSD and reUSDe, plus fees recorded in the fee vault

Re7 Labs.fees: Total yields from deposited assets in all curated vaults.

Ref Market.revenue: All protocol fees (10% of referral rewards) go to the ref_market treasury.
Ref Market.fees: The protocol fee on every referral bounty that pays out: 10% of the reward, paid by the referrer.

Relay.revenue: Platform fees. This is an upper bound: Relay pays qualifying integrators an undisclosed 0-67% revenue share out of it.
Relay.fees: Platform fees, integrator app fees and swap costs paid by users on Relay bridges and swaps, excluding execution costs (network gas).

Relend Network.fees: Total yields from deposited assets in all curated vaults.

Reserve Protocol.revenue: Includes some percentage of yields going to RSR token stakers, 100% of platform fee going to RSR buy back and burn
Reserve Protocol.fees: Includes tvl fee, mint fee, platform fee, yields of yield DTF's, governance fee

Revert Lend.revenue: Interest retained by the protocol vault as reserves via the reserve factor.
Revert Lend.fees: Total interest paid by borrowers on their loans plus liquidation bonuses paid by liquidated borrowers.

Revoke.cash.revenue: All batch revoke fees and subscription payments, kept by Revoke.cash.
Revoke.cash.fees: Batch revoke fees ($1.50 per batch, paid in the native token by free users) and Revoke Premium and Ultimate subscription payments in USDC and USDT. Refunds are not deducted.

Rheo.revenue: Percentage of interest going to treasury
Rheo.fees: Swap fees are applied on every cash-for-credit trade, and fragmentation fees are charged on every credit split

River Omni-CDP.revenue: River: Borrow and redemption fees to stability pool and satUSD+ holders. NYM: All swap fees to RewardManager for stakers.
River Omni-CDP.fees: Combined fees from River Protocol (borrow, redemption, liquidation) and NYM Protocol (swap in/out fees).

RockawayX.fees: Total yields from deposited assets in all curated vaults.

Royco V1.revenue: The amount of incentive/reward goes to Royco Protocol.
Royco V1.fees: Total incentive/reward amount were committed by Incentive Providers.

Rubicon.revenue: Protocol cut: Aquila V2 ~5 bps (1/6 of LP fee) on OP/Arb/Base where factory.feeTo is set, 0 on mainnet; CLMM V3 read live per-pool per-timeslot from pool.slot0().feeProtocol (currently 1/6 on the Arbitrum and Base pools checked, 0 where the fee switch is off), so historical periods before any fee-switch change are attributed correctly; Classic 100% of the 2 bps taker fee.
Rubicon.fees: Total user-paid trading fees across all four systems: Aquila V2 = 30 bps × swap notional, CLMM V3 = per-pool tier (5/30/100 bps) × swap notional, Classic = 2 bps × take-event notional.

RubyScore.revenue: All received native coin is treated as revenue.
RubyScore.fees: All received native coin is treated as revenue.

Ryze Protocol.revenue: What the protocol keeps: 100% of taker fees, 25% of weight-breaking fees, and 50% of captured slippage. There is no token-holder revenue yet — UNIT distribution is not live.
Ryze Protocol.fees: Every fee charged on a swap: the swap fee, taker fee, weight-breaking fee, and captured slippage.

SMARDEX AMM.revenue: 0.02% of each swap on Ethereum is collected for staking pool (SDEX holders that staked). On other chains, 0.03% of each swap is collected for buybacks and burns. Refer to https://docs.smardex.io/overview/what-is-smardex/fees for detailed information.
SMARDEX AMM.fees:
A minor fee is collected on each swap, functioning as trading fees.
The fees are set at 0.07% on Ethereum and 0.1% on other chains.
On other networks, fees may vary between different pairs and chains.
Refer to https://docs.smardex.io/overview/what-is-smardex/fees for detailed information.

SOCKET Protocol.revenue: Total fees paid are distributed to SOCKET inetrgations.
SOCKET Protocol.fees: Total fees paid by users for bridging tokens.

Sablier Legacy.revenue: All of it. The fee is Sablier's only income and none of it is shared with liquidity providers, stream creators, or integrators.
Sablier Legacy.fees: The flat fee users pay when they claim tokens from a Sablier stream or airdrop. It is charged in the chain's native coin and targets a fixed dollar amount (around $1, waived to $0 on most chains since 22 April 2026, though the Sablier app still attaches it by default). Nothing is charged as a percentage of the tokens being streamed. Counted from 3 February 2025, the day Sablier began charging.

Safe.revenue: All fees paid out to Safe are collected by Safe.
Safe.fees: Partner fee on swaps made with Safe through CoW Swap, as paid out weekly by CoW Protocol, net of CoW's cut.

Scale.revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders

Scrooge DEX Aggregator.revenue: Scrooge's fee on each swap: taken by ScroogeRouter on Robinhood Chain, paid as Relay's app fee on swaps through Relay, and paid in SOL to Scrooge's Solana fee wallet on Solana. The fee a partner site adds goes to that site and is not included.
Scrooge DEX Aggregator.fees: Scrooge's fee, taken by ScroogeRouter from each swap's output (the fee field of Swapped and SwappedMany), plus the fee a site embedding Scrooge's swap widget charges on top through ScroogePartner (at most 1%). On swaps through Relay, Scrooge's app fee as Relay reports it paid to Scrooge's fee wallet: on swaps under Scrooge's referrer "scrooge.exchange" since 2026-10-29, and before then, when Scrooge's swaps carried no referrer, on the ones Relay filled for Scrooge's app, listed by id. On Solana, the SOL the swap paid Scrooge's fee wallet or its wrapped-SOL account. Fees of the underlying venues and pools are not included. Scrooge takes no fee on swaps through LI.FI.

Seamless V1.revenue: Percentage of interest going to treasury

Seamless V2.revenue: All mint and redeem fees, management fees are protocol revenue.
Seamless V2.fees: Management fees and Mint and redeem fees collected from leverage token operations. Fees are calculated as a percentage of the assets being minted or redeemed, as defined in each leverage token configuration.

Seamless Vaults.fees: Total yields from deposited assets in all curated vaults.

SharesGram.revenue: Fees paid by users while trading on social network.
SharesGram.fees: Fees paid by users while trading on social network.

Shift Protocol.revenue: Performance fees (5-20%) on vault profits and management fees (0-2% annually) on AUM, all accruing to the protocol treasury.
Shift Protocol.fees: All yields generated by Shift Protocol vaults from delta-neutral strategies, basis trading, and LP positions, plus performance fees and management fees.

Shiny.revenue: Fees minus referral commissions: what Shiny keeps from pack spend after sellback payouts and referral commissions.
Shiny.fees: Pack and battle spend minus sellback payouts to players.

Smithii.revenue: All fees are collected by smithii.io protocol.
Smithii.fees: All fees paid by users to use a particular Smithii tool.

Snuggle.revenue: The share of the 15% performance fee that lands in the vault treasury. The part paid out to a position owner's referrer is counted as supply side instead.
Snuggle.fees: Trading fees and staking rewards earned by the concentrated liquidity positions the vaults manage, scaled up from the performance fee the vault moved to its treasury.

SoSoValue Basis.revenue: All services fees paid by users.
SoSoValue Basis.fees: Yield generated from delta hedging strategies plus daily service fee of 0.01% based on the value of the underlying assets.

SoSoValue Indexes.revenue: All services fees paid by users.
SoSoValue Indexes.fees: The protocol charges a daily service fee of 0.01% based on the value of the underlying assets.

Sobal.revenue: Protocol revenue from all fees collected
Sobal.fees: All trading fees collected (doesn't include withdrawal and flash loan fees)

Solidly V3.revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders

SolvBTC.revenue: Protocol share of staking rewards plus all mint/redemption fees collected by Solv Protocol.
SolvBTC.fees: All yields are generated from staking assets and mint/redemption fees.

Spectra V2.revenue: Yield trading fees, voting fees, and voting incentives distributed to veSPECTRA holders.
Spectra V2.fees: Yield trading fees paid by users plus voting fees and voting incentives distributed through Spectra governance.

Spiko.revenue: Spiko management fees on assets under management: 0.25%/yr for the T-bill funds (USTBL/EUTBL/UKTBL), 0.10%/yr for the Cash & Carry funds (SPKCC/eurSPKCC), and 0.25%/yr for the Amundi Overnight Swap funds (SAFO/eurSAFO/gbpSAFO/chfSAFO). The Cash & Carry funds also charge a 25% performance fee above the risk-free rate (SOFR) that is not captured, since only the net NAV is published on-chain.
Spiko.fees: Net NAV growth from Spiko funds (USTBL/EUTBL/UKTBL/SPKCC/eurSPKCC and the SAFO Amundi Overnight Swap funds) distributed to holders, plus Spiko's annual management fee. The published NAV is already net of fees, so the management fee is added on top to reconstruct gross fees.

Sport.fun.revenue: Dynamic Fees from player token purchase and sell.
Sport.fun.fees: Dynamic Fees are collected For player token purchase and sell.

Sprivio.revenue: The protocol's share of the base curve fee (10% normally, 30% once a chain is past its first 100 launches), half of the anti-snipe tax, all launch fees, and the full 2% graduation fee.
Sprivio.fees: 1% base fee on every bonding-curve buy and sell, plus the creator's optional tax, plus the anti-snipe tax charged in the first 3 seconds of a launch, plus a flat launch fee per token (read live from each chain's factory), plus 2% of the raise taken when a curve graduates to Uniswap v4.

SquaDeFi.revenue: Fees paid by users while trading on social network.
SquaDeFi.fees: Fees paid by users while trading on social network.

SquadSwap Thanos.revenue: Share of swap fees collected by the protocol.
SquadSwap Thanos.fees: Total swap fees paid by users.

Squeeze.revenue: Squeeze platform share — EVM: 47.5% of Doppler swap fees claimed via collectFees; Solana: LaunchLab platform fees to the claim wallet.
Squeeze.fees: On Base/Robinhood: gross Doppler pool trading fees (2.5%), extrapolated from Squeeze’s 47.5% Doppler fee-collect receipts. On Solana: LaunchLab *platform* fees claimed to Squeeze’s claim wallet only (not creator/protocol/referral cuts).

Stabull Finance.revenue: 30% of all fees goes to the protocol treasury
Stabull Finance.fees: Stabull charges a flat rate of 0.15% per swap per pool

Stargate V1.revenue: Total bridge fees paid by users
Stargate V1.fees: Total bridge fees paid by users

Stargate V2.revenue: Total bridge fees paid by users
Stargate V2.fees: All fees paid by users while using Stargate bridge.

Steakhouse Financial.fees: Total yields from deposited assets in all curated vaults.

Steer Protocol.revenue: Part of swap fees collected as revenue for the protocol.
Steer Protocol.fees: Includes swap fees earned by providing liquidity to various pools of different protocols.

Stochastic Finance.revenue: Equal to Fees (sum of `OptionExercised` and `PositionClosed` fees): the protocol has no governance token, and every fee is transferred to the on-chain `feeCollector_address` (which the owner can rotate via `setFeeCollector` / `FeeCollectorChanged`).
Stochastic Finance.fees: Sum of `fee` fields from `OptionExercised` (settlement fee on each exercised leg) and `PositionClosed` (matched-pair close fee). Both are charged at `1 / sf_fee_divisor` of the exercised/closed collateral and paid in USDC.

StonkBrokers Anvil.revenue: 30% of NFTFi ETH fees, the full $STONKBROKER activation fee (burn + protocol), and the Stonk Interns protocol share (75% of the ETH mint leg, 100% of the STONK leg and promotion fee, the full intern activation fee).
StonkBrokers Anvil.fees: ETH fees on NFT AMM trades + NFT-backed loans; $STONKBROKER broker activation/upgrade fees; Stonk Interns mint fees (ETH leg, $STONKBROKER leg, $1 promotion fee) and intern activation fees; and the Relay swap-desk 1% app fee (Base USDC forwarded to StockBooster).

StonkBrokers Safety Deposit Box.revenue: 10% of locker protocol cuts and vesting-locker deposit fees.
StonkBrokers Safety Deposit Box.fees: Safety Deposit Box liquidity-locker protocol cuts (Uniswap V3/V4 + up. DEX v2/CL lockers) from LockFeesCollected / LockLiquidityDecreased / LockTokensPaid; LP trading fees claimed through the locked positions (the lock owner's 80% share of LockFeesCollected plus gauge rewards from LockTokensPaid); and StonkVestingLocker 0.01% deposit fees.

StratEx.revenue: 100% of collected fees are sent to the protocol treasury (feeReceiver). Revenue equals total fees collected.
StratEx.fees: Stratex collects entrance fees (0.2%) on deposits and exit fees (0.2%) on withdrawals from ERC4626 vaults. All fees are tracked via FeeAccrued events emitted by vault contracts.

Stryke CLAMM.revenue: All protocol fees go to the Stryke feeTo address.
Stryke CLAMM.fees: Protocol fees charged on top of the premium (a fixed percentage of premiumAmount set in the CLAMM FeeStrategy) and sent to the feeTo address. Premiums to LPs are not included.

Sumer.money.revenue: Protocol and holders share of interest

Summer.fi Pro.fees: Counts the 0.2% fee taken on swaps.

SuperSwap Ink DEX Aggregator.revenue: All fees are retained by SuperSwap.
SuperSwap Ink DEX Aggregator.fees: V2 swaps charge 0.25% for in-chain swaps and 0.35% for cross-chain portal swaps.

Superchain.revenue: All fees are collected by OP Labs.
Superchain.fees: Services fees paid by blockchain using OP Stack and registered on Superchain.

Superform.revenue: Performance and management fees collected by Superform.
Superform.fees: Total yield from deposited assets across all SuperVaults.

Superfund.revenue: 10% of the yield charged as a protocol fee
Superfund.fees: Total yield earned by the superfund through the allocation of funds across various protocols

Surf Liquid.fees: All the yield earned across all Morpho vault positions, calculated from share price changes.

Surge Credit.revenue: Protocol reserve share of borrow interest (reserveRateBps), from the protocolCut field of the InterestAccrued event.
Surge Credit.fees: Borrow interest paid by borrowers on Bitcoin-collateralised USDC loans.

SushiSwap.revenue: A share of each trade fee goes to xSUSHI stakers.
SushiSwap.fees: SushiSwap Classic charges a flat 0.3% fee.

SushiSwap Agg.fees: Trading fees paid by users while using Sushi Aggregator Routers.

SushiSwap V3.revenue: The share of each swap fee Sushi keeps rather than paying to liquidity providers - nothing on most pools, 25% where the protocol fee is switched on, and 50% on Katana
SushiSwap V3.fees: Traders pay a swap fee set per pool, from 0.01% to 1% on most chains and up to 4% on Katana

SwapBased AMM.revenue: All revenue generated comes from user fees.
SwapBased AMM.fees: All fees come from the user.

SwapBased Concentrated Liquidity.revenue: Protocol's share of trading fees (25%-34% per pool, read from each swap's emitted protocolFeesToken0/1). Docs state protocol revenue is shared with xBASE stakers, but no treasury/staker split is published.
SwapBased Concentrated Liquidity.fees: Trading fees paid by swappers, equal to each pool's fee tier.

Sweep n Flip.revenue: Includes 2.5% marketplace fees going to the protocol.
Sweep n Flip.fees: Includes 2.5% marketplace fees and 2% LP fees.

Symbiosis.revenue: The symbiosis share of partner fees, the octopool fee share sent to the protocol fee receiver, and the whole bridging fee, which is paid to the bridge contract.
Symbiosis.fees: Partner fees charged on swaps routed through symbiosis, octopool swap fees on the symbiosis chain, and the stableBridgingFee deducted on every cross chain transfer.

SynFutures V3.fees: fees paid by takers on the protocol by using market orders, these fees paid goes to limit order makers, AMM LP and protocol fees

Synapse Cross Chain Bridge.revenue: Bridge fees, AMM admin fees, flash loan protocol fees, CCTP protocol fees, FastBridge protocol fees, and MessageBus fees accrued to Synapse contracts.
Synapse Cross Chain Bridge.fees: Bridge, AMM, flash loan, CCTP, RFQ, and messaging fees paid by users and emitted by Synapse contracts.

Synthetix V3.revenue: Fees paid by users and awarded to LPs

THORChain DEX.revenue: The share of swap fees burned as RUNE (1% since 2026-09-12, 5% before) - value to all RUNE holders - plus protocol-kept income (outbound fees net of the gas reimbursed to nodes, slashing fees, developer fund, marketing fund and the 20% directed into protocol-owned liquidity). The node-bonder share of swap fees is treated as a security cost and the LP, affiliate and TCY shares as supplier payments, so none of those count as revenue.
THORChain DEX.fees: Slip-based liquidity (swap) fees paid by users on each chain's THORChain pools, gross outbound fees and slashing fees paid into the Reserve, and affiliate fees charged by interfaces/wallets (affiliate fees are attributed to the THORChain native chain). RUNE block-reward emissions and the native tx fee (counted in the THORChain chain fees adapter) are excluded.

THORSwap.revenue: All swap fees, split between the treasury and THOR stakers and buyback.
THORSwap.fees: Swap fees users pay the protocol on top of the route, counted in the hour the swap was created on the chain it sold from. The protocol started charging swap fees on 2022-04-24, so fees before that date are zero.

TRDEFI.revenue: The entire collected trading fee. TRDEFI retains 100% of it, with no share paid to suppliers or holders.
TRDEFI.fees: 0.05% of the amount traded, collected by TRDEFI on positions created through its venue. The fee is embedded in the maker's signed order and paid to the receiver address when the position trades, so it is counted as the incoming token transfers it actually is. The fee rail has been in force since 2026-09-25; positions created before that carry no fee and are immutable.

TeraSwap.revenue: A flat 0.1% (10 bps) fee taken by the FeeCollector on every swap, read directly from the feeAmount field of each SwapWithFee event (no estimation — the exact on-chain value).
TeraSwap.fees: A flat 0.1% (10 bps) fee taken by the FeeCollector on every swap, read directly from the feeAmount field of each SwapWithFee event (no estimation — the exact on-chain value).

TermiX.revenue: 100% of protocol fees (2% of settlements) go to the protocol fee recipient.
TermiX.fees: 2% protocol fee charged on each settlement (jobs via escrow, campaigns via campaign vault), paid in USDC/USDT to the protocol fee recipient.

Terminal.revenue: Trading terminal fees retained by Pump.fun after cashback/referral payouts.
Terminal.fees: Trading fees paid by users while using Pump Trading Terminal(previously known as Padre).

The River.revenue: The treasury keeps the whole interface fee (0.10% of the trade value).
The River.fees: The River's 0.10% interface fee on market trades of tokenized stocks, paid by the trader in USDC (Base) or USDG (Robinhood Chain), read from RiverTaker RiverTake events and KyberSwap router Fee events that pay The River's treasury. Trades from The River's own test wallet are excluded.

Theo Straddle Vaults.fees: Trading PnL generated by Theo straddle vaults, PnL accrues to depositors.

Tizi.revenue: Portion of yield claimed by the protocol (profitNumerator / profitDenominator, default 10%).
Tizi.fees: Total staking yield generated from TD staking rewards.

Top.Market.revenue: Pack sales net of refunds and buybacks, minus payouts to third-party card stakers, referral commissions and draw fees sent to the Jackpot, plus marketplace fees. Payouts for cards staked by the platform's own wallets stay in revenue.
Top.Market.fees: USDC players pay to open card packs, net of refunds and instant buybacks of won cards, plus marketplace fees on card trades.

Topaz AMM.revenue: Includes swap fees and bribes going to holders

Topaz CL.revenue: Includes swap fees and bribes going to holders

Toros.revenue: All revenue collected by the Toros protocol.
Toros.fees: All fees generated from Toros vaults.

Treble Perps.revenue: builder code revenue from Symmio Perps Trades.
Treble Perps.fees: builder code fees from Symmio Perps Trades.

Tree News.revenue: All tokens burned by users for subscriptions.
Tree News.fees: All funds spent by users to subscribe. Includes direct token burns, and USDC used to buy and burn.

Tristero Darkpool.revenue: The loan spread, kept by the protocol. Tristero takes no share of gas abstraction.
Tristero Darkpool.fees: A 1bp (0.01%) per-day loan spread on the total capital in the Tristero vault - idle and lent out, from the vault's own getTVOL accounting - plus gas abstraction paid to fillers for submitting orders on takers' behalf. Both components are charged to users: the loan spread to borrowers, gas abstraction to takers.

Trueo.revenue: Swap fees that go to the protocol rather than to market creators or liquidity providers, plus all Launchpad fees.
Trueo.fees: Swap fees paid by traders: the TrueMarkets hook fee on Uniswap V4 market pools (0.2% on the original markets, 0.8% on Launchpad markets) and the Uniswap LP fee on market pools (0.8% on the original V4 markets, the pool fee tier on V3 markets), plus Launchpad fees charged on proposal graduation and Live-phase withdrawals. Fees taken in outcome tokens are valued at the price of the swap that paid them.

Trust Wallet Wallet.revenue: Fees collected by Trust Wallet, less the share of the Safe 0x92f980a7 that its sweeps send to SwapKit.
Trust Wallet Wallet.fees: All fees paid by users for swapping, bridging in Trust Wallet. Captured from ERC20 Transfer events into the fee collectors (USDC and 1%-scaled USDT), including the USDC NEAR Intents and Chainflip pay out to the Safe 0x92f980a7, from native gas-token internal transfers forwarded by the 0x Settler integrator, and from the CoW Swap partner fee that CoW Protocol pays out to Trust Wallet each week.

UNCX Network V2.revenue: All tracked fees are retained by UNCX.
UNCX Network V2.fees: Native and Token fees received by fee collector accounts from official locker and vesting contracts.

Umbrae.revenue: The protocol's share of swap fees accruing to the fee recipient, plus WETH credited to U1 lockers (including external funding).
Umbrae.fees: Swap fees on the listed DLMM and DAMM factories plus WETH credited to U1 lockers. Excludes aggregator, keeper, flash-loan and liquidity-composition fees. DLMM uses SwapDetailed; DAMM uses changes in protocol and LP fee accumulators plus claims, in each historical fee token.

Umia.revenue: What accrues to the protocol fee recipient: the protocol cut of spot and winning-proposal decision-market fees, plus the recipient's share of the LP half through vault shares it holds.
Umia.fees: Swap fees on each venture's Uniswap v4 spot pool, booked in the money token at each swap's realised price, plus the fees of the winning proposal in each decision market, recognised when its protocol cut is collected after settlement. Fees paid on losing proposals never become real tokens and are not counted.

UniDex Perp.revenue: Fees going to the treasury + holders
UniDex Perp.fees: Fees collected from user trading fees

Uniswap Labs.revenue: Trading fees are collected by Uniswap Labs.
Uniswap Labs.fees: All trading fees paid by users while using Uniswap frontend.

Uniswap V2.revenue: From 28 Dec 2025, 17% (0% before) fees on Ethereum, From 8 Mar 2026, 17% (0% before) fees on Optimism, Arbitrum, Base, Zora, XLayer chains shared to buy back and burn UNI. (Tracked combined in Uniswap V3 adapter)
Uniswap V2.fees: User pays 0.3% fees on each swap.

Uniswap V3.revenue: From 28 Dec 2025, a portion of fees a collected to buy back and burn UNI on Ethereum, From 8 Mar 2026, on Optimism, Arbitrum, Base, WC, Zora, XLayer, From 2 Jun 2026, on Polygon, BSC, Celo, From 27 Jul 2026, on Robinhood, From 5 Oct 2026, on Arc
Uniswap V3.fees: Swap fees from paid by users.

Uniswap V4.revenue: Fee switch enabled on 27 Jul 2026 (tracked in uniswap-v3 adapter), a part of fees collected to buy back and burn UNI.
Uniswap V4.fees: Swap fees paid by users, excluding wash trading and swaps settled with no tokens changing hands.

UniversalX.revenue: 1% of volume fees collected by universalX
UniversalX.fees: 1% of volume fees collected by universalX

Unlock Protocol.revenue: Unlock DAO keeps the protocol fee (1% of each key purchase/renewal).
Unlock Protocol.fees: Gross network product delta recorded by each Unlock contract across supported chains.

Upshift.revenue: Performance fees and management fees paid from user yields.
Upshift.fees: All yields generated from deposited assets in all vaults.

Vailox.revenue: All escrow fees are kept by the protocol.
Vailox.fees: Escrow fees paid by sellers and buyers on completed P2P trades, read from EscrowComplete events. Fees are tiered by trade size (fixed fee below 50 USD, then 1.25% down to 0.25%) with a lower rate for verified merchants. Cancelled or refunded trades pay no fee.

VectaSwap.revenue: No protocol fee is charged on pool swaps: 0.
VectaSwap.fees: Swap fees paid by traders (0.01%, 0.035%, 0.05%, 0.3% or 1% per pool).

Veda.revenue: The amount of yields are distributed to Veda Protocol.
Veda.fees: Total yields are generated by staking assets.

Velora.revenue: Share of 80% trading fees to Velora, DAO, and token stakers.
Velora.fees: All trading fees paid by users

Venice.revenue: Excludes Venice's subscription, API, and credit/DIEM revenue, which settle off-chain (card / Coinbase Commerce / Stripe-Bridge) with no on-chain footprint. Includes only the VVV buy-and-burn (= HoldersRevenue).
Venice.fees: Excludes Venice's subscription, API, and credit/DIEM revenue, which settle off-chain (card / Coinbase Commerce / Stripe-Bridge) with no on-chain footprint. Includes only the on-chain VVV buy-and-burn (USD value of VVV burned), which equals HoldersRevenue.

Venus Core Pool.revenue: Protocol and holders share of borrow interest, plus liquidation income received by ProtocolShareReserve.
Venus Core Pool.fees: Total interest paid by borrowers and liquidation income received by ProtocolShareReserve.

Veranta.revenue: Liquidation and TP/SL execution fees kept by the protocol's keepers, plus the protocol's share of opening, closing and profit-share fees after referral rebates (20% until 2024-08-21, 40% until 2025-09-08, 0% until 2026-03-10, 30% since).
Veranta.fees: Opening and closing fees, liquidation fees, the profit share charged on winning Upside (zero-fee) trades, and rollover fees for holding positions. Funding is paid between traders and is not counted.

Vesper V1.fees: Tracks vaTokens minted to Vesper's Fee Recipient address.

Vexy.revenue: All the fee is kept as revenue
Vexy.fees: 1% fee charged on each trade of veNft

Vibe Trading.revenue: builder code revenue from Symmio Perps Trades.
Vibe Trading.fees: builder code fees from Symmio Perps Trades.

Virtuals Protocol.revenue: The part kept by the Virtuals treasury: all bonding-curve tax and launch fees of the original launch model, and its share of the agent-token trading tax (about 20% from December 2024 to March 2025, 30% since April 2025).
Virtuals Protocol.fees: Fees paid to Virtuals Protocol: the 1% trading tax on agent tokens, plus the bonding-curve tax and agent launch fees of the original launch model. The agent-token tax is measured where it is paid out (Base and Robinhood tax managers, the Solana distributor) or where it accrues before being split (Arc tax vault, Ethereum tax wallet).

Virtus Protocol AMM.revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders

Virtus Protocol CL.revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders

VolBoost.revenue: Fees paid by users while using boost services.
VolBoost.fees: Fees paid by users while using boost services.

Voodoo Trade Base.revenue: Revenue is 70% of all collected fees, which goes to VMX stakers
Voodoo Trade Base.fees: Fees from open/close position (0.1%), swap (0.18% to 0.8%), mint and burn (based on tokens balance in the pool) and hourly borrow fee ((assets borrowed)/(total assets in pool)*0.0045%)

Votre.revenue: Protocol share of the interest and late fees accrued
Votre.fees: Interest and late fees accrued to the supplier

WOOFi Swap.revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders

WeDeFin.revenue: Transaction, deposit & withdrawal fees collected by the protocol.
WeDeFin.fees: Fees for minting/rebalancing/selling the index, paid by users.

Whales Market.revenue: All fees collected by the protocol. No holders/protocol split is reported: current docs describe staker rewards only as open-market $WHALES buybacks with no stated share of fees. Affiliate/referral shares (up to 40% of a referred trade's fee per docs) are not separately identifiable on-chain; observed settlements send the full fee to the fee wallets, which are accumulate-only.
Whales Market.fees: All tokens received by the protocol's fee wallets (verified via the pre-market contracts' config/UpdateConfig history on EVM and the program config account on Solana): settlement fees from both sides and cancellation fees.

Wombat Exchange.revenue: Protocol share of swap fees plus bribes revenue distributed to WOM voters.
Wombat Exchange.fees: Swap fees paid by users plus bribes rewards deposited for Wombat gauges.

Xena Finance.revenue: 40% of the total fees goes to Treasury
Xena Finance.fees: Position fees (increase, decrease, liquidation) and liquidity fees are collected

Xpanse Perps.revenue: builder code revenue from Symmio Perps Trades.
Xpanse Perps.fees: builder code fees from Symmio Perps Trades.

YO Protocol.revenue: Yo protocol does not charge any fees.
YO Protocol.fees: Cumulative yield generated by yo protocol vaults + withdraw fees.

Yearn Curating.fees: Total yields from deposited assets in all curated vaults.

Yearn Finance.revenue: Performance and management fees to Yearn treasury
Yearn Finance.fees: Total yields from deposited assets across all vaults

YieldFi.revenue: Total management fees and performance fees charged by YieldFi.
YieldFi.fees: Total yield generated by YieldFi across all supported chains + management fees, performance fees by YieldFi

YieldNest.revenue: Amount of fees collected by YieldNest.
YieldNest.fees: Amount of fees collected by YieldNest.

ZNS Launchpad.revenue: Fees retained by ZNS: EVM launch fees and the exact treasury shares booked by the EVM fee locker; on Solana, the fixed 40% treasury share of ZNS partner trading fees. Solana no-referrer fallback is conservatively excluded until splitter distribution events are indexed by Dune.
ZNS Launchpad.fees: EVM token launch fees plus Uniswap v4 LP swap fees harvested from ZNS-launched pools; on Solana, wSOL-denominated Meteora DBC trading, protocol, and routing-referral fees paid by traders in the three wSOL production configs. DBC fees collected in a newly launched base token are excluded because that token cannot be reliably priced.

ZORA Coins.revenue: Portion of fees that go to the Zora protocol.
ZORA Coins.fees: All fees from trading coins, including: 1% Trade Rewards fee on direct Zora trades (0.5% to Creator, 0.15% to Trade Referrer, 0.15% to Create Referrer, 0.2% to Zora) and 1% Market Rewards fee on initial Uniswap market trades (0.5% to Creator, 0.25% to Create Referrer, 0.25% to Zora)

ZeroLend Lending.revenue: Percentage of interest going to treasury

ZyFAI.revenue: All fees are revenue for ZyFAI protocol
ZyFAI.fees: All fees from users by using AI agent services

aeon.revenue: 57% of swap fees routed to the Aeon treasury, per the on-chain beneficiary split read from the multicurve initializer, plus all client payments for security work.
aeon.fees: Dynamic swap fee (1.2% steady-state) paid by users trading on the WETH/AEON Uniswap v4 pool on Base, plus client payments for paid security work received by the dedicated Aeon client payments wallet. Liquidity is protocol-owned multicurve positions, there are no third-party LPs.

b402.fees: Tiered fees on private shielded transactions: $0.05 base + 0.05% (<$1k), 0.08% ($1k-$10k), 0.10% (>$10k). Collected as USDC transfers to fee collector at shield time.

basedbid.revenue: Revenue is measured only from FeeCollected inflows emitted by the treasury contract. On Solana, revenue equals tokens received by the BasedBid admin fee wallet in transactions involving the BasedBid program.
basedbid.fees: Fees include treasury revenue, BasedBid core fee-recipient events, and the swap fees distributed by BasedBid hooks on Uniswap v4 and PancakeSwap Infinity pools, each valued in the token it was paid in (any quote token a project launched against). On Solana, fees are the protocol fee share (creation, trading, finalize and LP-claim fees) received by the BasedBid admin fee wallet in transactions involving the BasedBid program.

clanker.revenue: Clanker protocol's cut: 20% of the creator LP fee charged on top of each swap. On Elysium (Clanker v5), the protocol's share of each swap's tax (10% of the tax, at least 0.5% and at most 1% of the trade), the anti-snipe surcharge, and dividend shares redirected to Clanker while no holder qualifies.
clanker.fees: Total swap fees paid by traders in Clanker-deployed Uniswap v4 pools (creator fee + Clanker's 20% of creator fee). On Elysium (Clanker v5), the buy and sell tax paid on every swap in a launch's pool, including the anti-snipe surcharge of its first seconds of trading; the part of the tax that is burned in the launched token is excluded.

copyfomo.revenue: Fees minus SupplySideRevenue, i.e. after the EVM bundler gas, the Solana fee payer cost and referral rewards: the service fee plus copyfomo's margin on gas, plus the $COPY creator fees (the 'token fees' figure on copyfomo.com/data). The 'protocol fees, after gas' figure on copyfomo.com/data is the service part before referral rewards.
copyfomo.fees: Everything traders pay copyfomo on every copied buy and sell (a 2% service fee plus the gas copyfomo fronts for them, billed back as one stablecoin transfer to the copyfomo treasury, counted on the day the fee is collected), plus the creator fees of the copyfomo token $COPY: the Pons launchpad hook takes 3% of every swap of the COPY/COIN pool on Robinhood Chain, of which 2.7% goes to the creator (1% hook fee, 70% to the creator, plus a 2% creator tax). Counted on the day of the trade, valued at the hourly COIN price. The fees are swept into COIN by Pons and claimed by copyfomo in batches later; the claims are not what is counted.

deBridge.revenue: Fees are distributed to deBridge protocol.
deBridge.fees: All fees paid by users for swap and bridge tokens via deBridge.

flaunch.revenue: Tokens trading and launching fees paid by users.
flaunch.fees: Tokens trading and launching fees paid by users.

flip by Spaace.fees: Total native ETH received by fee collector wallets on Base

flooor.fun.revenue: 0.5% of the winning bid goes to the protocol.
flooor.fun.fees: Counts the total fees charged on NFT sales (5% of the winning bid).

fly.trade.revenue: Swap fees routed to fly.trade's own fee collector, plus the retained positive slippage (surplus).
fly.trade.fees: Swap fees charged by fly.trade's DexAggregator (a conditional 0.01%-0.1% fee on long-tail assets and specific pairs) plus positive slippage (surplus) retained by the router, taken from each Swap event. Pre-2026-05-03 (router migration) fees are taken from the legacy fee collector.

fomo Wallet.revenue: FOMO's share of trading fees: USDC collected on native Solana swaps plus Relay platform fees. Referral fees are excluded.
fomo Wallet.fees: Trading fees paid by FOMO users on native Solana swaps and on cross-chain trades via Relay, attributed to the chain the trade settled on (Robinhood Chain, Base, BNB Chain, Ethereum, Arc, Monad, Elysium). Relay fees FOMO cannot attribute to a chain are counted on Solana.

friend.tech V1.revenue: Portion of fees collected by Friend Tech.

g8keep.revenue: Tokens trading and launching fees paid by users.
g8keep.fees: Tokens trading and launching fees paid by users.

iZiSwap.revenue: Share of swap fees each pool charges for the protocol, set per pool.
iZiSwap.fees: Swap fees paid by traders, the pool fee tier applied to each swap.

manifold.xyz.revenue: All fees collected by Manifold protocol.
manifold.xyz.fees: Fees paid by users for creating and publishing NFT.

o1 Launchpad.revenue: Actual platform and protocol-owned fixed-component swap credits, plus token-launch fees. Includes anti-snipe surcharges, referral fallback and rounding retained by the protocol. Claims do not count again.
o1 Launchpad.fees: Quote-denominated swap fees from Hook Trade events plus token-launch payment events across configured suites. Legacy launch-token-denominated swap fees are excluded because reliable historical USD valuation is unavailable. Crypto uses token balances; Stocks use the event-time factory tick reference price under the documented $4,000 opening-cap convention, with historical DefiLlama prices only when that reference is unavailable.

o1.exchange Trading Terminal.fees: User pays 1% fee on each trade

sasa.revenue: EVM: 70% of the collected swap fees, sent to sasa's fee vault. Solana: sasa's 50% of the creator fees, received by its treasury.
sasa.fees: EVM chains: swap fees of the pools sasa creates for every coin, counted when sasa's builder collects them: the quote-asset side (ETH, BNB or USDC) and the coin side (in the launched coin, valued where the coin has a price). Solana: the creator fees of coins launched on sasa (both halves).

scoop.revenue: Fees paid by users while trading on social network.
scoop.fees: Fees paid by users while trading on social network.

sedge.revenue: 0% of fees go to the protocol.
sedge.fees: Fees are collected from users on each trade.

time.fun.revenue: Fees paid by users while trading on social network.
time.fun.fees: Fees paid by users while trading on social network.

vfat Swap.revenue: All router fees go to the vfat.io fee collector.
vfat Swap.fees: The router fee (1 basis point of the output amount) paid by users on every swap.

vfat.io.revenue: All servuce fees collected by vfat.io.
vfat.io.fees: All fees paid by users using vfat.io services.

vibe.market.revenue: The protocol's share of trading fees (on Base 40% of each trade's fee since August 2025, 20% before, plus the referrer shares of trades that name no referrer), and half of the graduated Base card coins' pool fees.
vibe.market.fees: Trading fees paid on vibe.market card coins: the ETH fee on every Base card coin trade, the WETH side of the Uniswap pool fees earned by graduated Base card coins, and the WETH fees collected by vibe.market's Robinhood Chain pack markets. Fees paid in $SPORTS or in card coins are not priced and are excluded.

wstO Vault.revenue: No swap burn fees are retained as protocol revenue; all accrue to vault stakers.
wstO Vault.fees: wstO taken from every swap in wstO/launch-token pairs and burned, valued as the O it redeems for in that chain's vault.

zERC20.revenue: All v2 withdrawal and note-merge fees and all v1 redeem and unwrap fees paid by users are kept by the protocol.
zERC20.fees: Fees users pay to move tokens privately: since 2026-10-20 a v2 withdrawal fee (0.35% below $10k, tapering to 0.08% above $10M) and a small fee for merging notes, plus on v1 a 0.35% redeem fee on private transfers (since 2026-06-02) and an unwrap fee for converting zTokens back to the underlying token that rises as liquidity runs low; relayer and third-party referral fees are excluded.
